> **Template (`TASK_actg175_binary_campaign_2026-09-17` §1.3).** One committed
> file runs every cell of the ACTG175 binary/OR design: each knob reads an
> `FS_OR_*` environment variable first and falls back to the in-file default, so
> an unattended driver renders
> `FS_OR_TARGET=1.5 FS_OR_N=2000 FS_OR_CAMPAIGN=orfs quarto render <this file> --output …`
> without editing the template. Every resolved value is echoed below and lands
> in the bundle's `meta`. The committed study
> (`maxeffCons_mr_coverage_sweep_or075.qmd` and its `mr_sweep/` payloads) is not
> touched: this document writes under its own stem token (`mr_field`), its own
> results root (`mr_or_harm/`) and a mandatory campaign tag, and refuses to
> overwrite any git-tracked bundle.

# What this evaluates {#sec-intro}

Per replicate, identify $\hat H$ on the ACTG175-anchored binary/OR
super-population with one of three identifiers (`FS_OR_METHOD` =
`consistency` | `grf` | `dina`) under `sg_focus = "effMaxSG"` and the band rule,
then compute — on the same data and the same selected subgroup — the
within-subgroup odds ratio and its intervals:

* **oracle** $\hat\theta(Q)$ — logistic refit on the true region, with its Wald
  interval;
* **naive** $\hat\theta(\hat H)$ — the plug-in on the selected region with its
  Wald interval;
* **MR (IJ)** $\tilde\theta(\hat H)$ — the two-term de-biased
  multiplier-resampling estimate with its infinitesimal-jackknife interval (the
  construction the committed study ran, there as its only one);
* **MR (field)** — `ci_method = "field"`: the shrunk-field estimator `est2` and
  the Λ*-quantile intervals; its **one-sided lower bound** (harm claim) is the
  directional product on $\hat H$;
* **complement field** (`field_complement = TRUE`) and its **field-s**
  companion (`field_scale_complement = "selected"`) — Λ*ᶜ from the same
  multipliers and winners; the **one-sided upper bound** on $\hat H^{c}$ is the
  directional product there;
* **joint pair** — simultaneous ($\hat H$ lower, $\hat H^{c}$ upper) from the
  aligned draws: separate / Bonferroni / calibrated, with `joint_s` mirroring
  the field-s pair;
* **FB** — never run and never joined on this path (there is no committed FB
  bundle for the binary design): the `fb_*` recorder columns are kept for schema
  parity with the MD template and stay all-NA.

Scoring uses the exact conditional estimand $\beta(\hat H)$ on the DGM
super-population (`fs_attach_betaHhat()` on the full evaluation frame), the
per-replicate oracle, and the study's two population references — $\theta^{\dagger}$
(the marginal OR in the block) and $\theta^{\ddagger}$ (the controlled direct
effect) — recorded per replicate as `C_dagger_*` / `C_ddagger_*`.

**Scale and orientation.** `adverse_outcome = TRUE`: the analysis runs directly
on the adverse outcome `y_neg` ("no CD4 improvement at week 20"), so **OR > 1 is
harm** and no orientation flip is applied anywhere — `.orient` is the identity.
Every estimate and every bound in this document is an **odds ratio** (positive);
biases are reported both as OR differences and, in SD units, on the **log-OR**
scale. Bounds are read by **location against clinically meaningful OR
thresholds** (the ladder τ = 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.25, 1.5, 2.0), never as
significance at OR = 1: on $\hat H$ a lower bound ≥ τ reads "harm of at least τ";
on $\hat H^{c}$ an upper bound ≤ τ reads "harm of at most τ".

**Conditional-family reading (governing constraint).** GRF's and DINA's
candidate families are generated from fitted surfaces, so the fixed-family
condition does not hold for them: **every coverage figure on those two paths is
coverage of the estimand conditional on the proposed family.** FS's family is
the prespecified cut grid. Comparisons across the three identifiers are
descriptive.

## Swap ledger — every deviation from the two sources, named {#sec-ledger}

Sources, quoted throughout: **[MD]** =
`../continuous/sim_fs_maxeffCons_mr_field_md_template.qmd` (the structure being
copied); **[S]** = `maxeffCons_mr_coverage_sweep_or075.qmd` (the committed study
driver, this task's source for the data recipe, seeds, truths and detector
settings); **[S10]**/**[S15]** = `../binary/mr_coverage_sweep_or10.qmd` /
`mr_coverage_sweep_or15.qmd` (consulted for `target_or_h` and calibration
settings only).

| block | taken from | change |
|---|---|---|
| YAML, prose, chunk order, summary layer | [MD] :1–15, :30–89, :1235–2019 | retitled; the scale is the OR (see below) |
| knobs | [MD] :93–374 | renamed `FS_OR_*`; `FS_OR_TARGET` and `FS_OR_N` replace `FS_MD_MD`/`FS_MD_N`; `FS_MD_KNOISE`, `FS_MD_BUILD`, `FS_MD_QUICKRUN`, `FS_MD_FB*`, `FS_MD_UNIFORM`, `FS_MD_DMIN_GRF` and `FS_MD_JOIN_SKIP` dropped (pinned to the study's / the campaign's literal) |
| the band-width guard | [MD] :156–164 | a NOTE replaces the hard error: [MD]'s default eps was the package's own (0.10), so unset reproduced its committed renders; here the default is the campaign's 0.20, and §1.5(a) must render the STUDY's rule (`maxeffCons` at eps 0.10), which the study driver itself sets ([S] :151–154). eps is still recorded in `meta` and still tags the stem |
| data preparation, DGM build, truth, evaluation frame | [S] :233–341 verbatim | `target_effect = FS_OR_TARGET` only ([S] :245 `target_or_h`; reachable range `k_inter_range = c(0.3, 1.5)` is [S] :222, and is [S10] :222 / [S15] :222 unchanged) |

| oracle | [S] :360–380 (`.logit_or_ci`) | recorded under [MD]'s `or_*` names, not [S]'s `ora_*`, so `fs_sim_bias_coverage(target = "oracle")` reads it unrenamed |
| thresholds and search settings | [S] :175–207 | `sg_focus`, `effect_neighborhood`, `selection_rule` from the knobs (the dispositions: `effMaxSG`, 0.20, `neighborhood`) in place of [S]'s `maxeffCons` / 0.10 |
| GRF and DINA arguments | [S] :205–207 verbatim | none (`dmin.grf = 0.0`, frontier/effect/depth 2; DINA `effect`, `dina_args = list()`) |

| `betaHhat` attachment | [S] :703–707 verbatim | none |
| `meta` and poolability keys | [MD] :1135–1175, :1210–1225 | plus `target_or_h`, the five truths, `sg_quantile`, `n_super`, `eval_seed`, `seed_scheme`, `outcome_type`, `effect_measure` and the thresholds ([S] :716–748) |

| `fs_dgm_scale()` / the SCALE CHECK | [MD] :442, :1367–1377 | **dropped**: `fs_dgm_scale()` refuses ratio measures (`R/fs_dgm_scale.R:130`). `dgm_scale <- NULL`, so [MD]'s own `is.null()` guards skip the check and the payload's `scale` element |
| `fs_mr_oc_summary()` | [MD] :1136, :1215 | kept; the truth list carries `effect_Q`/`effect_Qc`/`prevalence_Q`/`beta_inter` aliases (`R/fs_mr_oc_summary.R:131–190` reads those names) beside the study's own |

[MD]'s identity-scale summary treats them as one scale; here every Λ-SD ratio is taken against SD(log est) and the `est2`/bound identities are written on the log scale |

The classification table, the covariate-frequency figure and the realized-rules table are kept, re-pointed at wtkg / cd40 |
| FB join | [MD] :1052–1080 | **dropped** (no committed binary FB bundle); `fb_mode` pinned `"none"`, `fb_*` columns kept all-NA |

# Setup — all knobs {#sec-setup}

```{r setup-knobs}
#| message: false
.t0_doc <- Sys.time()   # start of document wall-clock (total reported at the end)
# forestsearch must be INSTALLED (devtools::install()), not load_all(): the
# doFuture workers spawn separate R processes that only see the installed
# package.  ([MD] :96-98)
library(forestsearch)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(speff2trial); library(doFuture); library(foreach); library(data.table)
})

# ── Environment overrides (FS_OR_*) ─────────────────────────────────────────
# [MD] :104-107, renamed.
.env_chr <- function(k, d) { v <- Sys.getenv(k, unset = NA); if (is.na(v) || !nzchar(v)) d else v }
.env_int <- function(k, d) as.integer(.env_chr(k, d))
.env_num <- function(k, d) as.numeric(.env_chr(k, d))

# ── Parallelization topology ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# "sims": replicates fan out across workers; the search and the MR gate run
# sequentially within each replicate.  [MD] :109-116; [S] :108-117 makes the
# same choice for the same reason (no inner bootstrap).
parallel_mode <- "sims"
.phys_minus1 <- max(1L, parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE) - 1L)
n_workers    <- min(.env_int("FS_OR_WORKERS", .phys_minus1), .phys_minus1)

# ── Counts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
n_sims       <- .env_int("FS_OR_NSIMS", 1000L)   # replicates in THIS batch
diag_mode    <- FALSE   # TRUE caps to 5 reps and relays worker errors verbatim
nb_boots     <- NULL    # FB is NEVER run in this document; see fb_mode
mr_draws     <- 5000L   # MR multiplier draws ([S] :86, the committed value)
k_random_noise <- 0L    # [S] :129, pinned: no noise confounders on this design

# ── Batching across renders (seed-disjoint pieces; pool via combine) ────────
# Seeds come from the pre-generated table indexed by GLOBAL sim_id ([S]
# :119-133), so disjoint sim_id ranges across renders pool to exactly one big
# run and results are invariant to worker count and batch position.
run_mode     <- .env_chr("FS_OR_MODE", "batch")   # "batch" (run + save one piece) | "combine" (merge + report)
stopifnot(run_mode %in% c("batch", "combine"))
sim_id_start <- .env_int("FS_OR_START", 1L)

# ── Seeds: PRE-GENERATED, indexed by GLOBAL replicate id ([S] :119-133) ─────
# VERBATIM from the study driver, including MAX_SIMS = 5000 and the generator
# state at the point of the draw (R's default kind; the per-replicate switch to
# L'Ecuyer-CMRG happens inside record_replicate(), after this table is built).
seed_base  <- 8316951L
MAX_SIMS   <- 5000L
set.seed(seed_base)
SEED_TABLE <- sample.int(.Machine$integer.max - 1L, MAX_SIMS)
seed_for <- function(sim_id) {
  if (sim_id < 1L || sim_id > MAX_SIMS)
    stop("sim_id ", sim_id, " outside the pre-generated seed table.")
  SEED_TABLE[sim_id]
}
seed_scheme <- "pre-generated table indexed by global sim_id"

# ── The identifier: engine + focus (these ARE the estimator; they feed the stem)
# [MD] :133-148, renamed.  Default-inert: unset resolves to "consistency".
subgroup_method <- .env_chr("FS_OR_METHOD", "consistency")  # "consistency" | "dina" | "grf"
stopifnot(subgroup_method %in% c("consistency", "dina", "grf"))
sg_focus        <- .env_chr("FS_OR_FOCUS", "effMaxSG")      # the dispositions' rule
stopifnot(sg_focus %in% c("effMaxSG", "maxeffCons", "effMinSG", "maxSG", "minSG", "maxeff"))
.band_foci <- c("effMaxSG", "effMinSG")
# Band half-width ([MD] :149-164): effect >= (1 - eps) * max effect among the
# qualifying candidates, on the harm-oriented scale; forwarded to the gate
# unchanged by forestsearch() as `nbhd`.  Read HERE, before the stem, because a
# non-default value tags the stem below.
effect_neighborhood <- .env_num("FS_OR_NBHD", 0.20)         # the dispositions' eps
stopifnot(is.finite(effect_neighborhood), effect_neighborhood >= 0, effect_neighborhood < 1)
# DEVIATION from [MD] :156-164, named: [MD] makes a non-band focus with FS_MD_NBHD set a hard
# error, because there its default (0.10) was already forestsearch()'s own, so leaving it unset
# reproduced every committed non-band render exactly.  Here the default is the campaign's 0.20,
# so the same rule would make the STUDY's rule (maxeffCons at eps 0.10) unreachable -- and §1.5(a)
# must render exactly that.  The study driver itself sets effect_neighborhood = 0.10 alongside
# sg_focus = "maxeffCons" ([S] :151-154), so this is the study's own practice.  A NOTE replaces
# the stop, and eps is still recorded in meta and still tags the stem.
if (!sg_focus %in% .band_foci)
  cat(sprintf("NOTE: sg_focus '%s' is not a band focus, so effect_neighborhood = %.2f is forwarded but INERT (the identifier does not consult it); it is still recorded in meta and tags the stem.\n",
              sg_focus, effect_neighborhood))

# ── Cell: design point and sample size ──────────────────────────────────────
# FS_OR_TARGET = the planted marginal OR in the harm subgroup H, the ONLY thing
# that changes between the three design points (the dispositions):
#   0.75 -> the supplement's protective design ([S] :125);
#   1.5  -> harm ([S15] :125);
#   1.0  -> borderline null: the planted region AT the null against a protective
#           complement, as [S10] :125 has it.  [S]'s homogeneous
#           dgm_model = "null" branch ([S] :275-294) is NOT used here.
target_or_h <- .env_num("FS_OR_TARGET", 0.75)
stopifnot(is.finite(target_or_h), target_or_h > 0)
dgm_model   <- "alt"    # pinned: the calibrated planted-region branch ([S] :123)
n_sample    <- .env_int("FS_OR_N", 500L)

method_tag <- if (identical(subgroup_method, "consistency")) "fs" else subgroup_method
# One source of truth: fs_focus_tag() holds the (subgroup_method, sg_focus)
# -> stem tag map for every driver ([MD] :183-188).
focus_tag <- forestsearch::fs_focus_tag(subgroup_method, sg_focus)
if (!identical(focus_tag, sg_focus))
  cat(sprintf("NOTE: sg_focus '%s' is an alias on the %s path; output stem uses focus tag '%s'.\n",
              sg_focus, subgroup_method, focus_tag))

# TEMPLATE STEM (collision guards, [MD] :190-216):
#   1. the token is "mr_field" and the results root is "mr_or_harm", so no
#      output of this document can glob-match the committed study's
#      "mr_sweep/<run_tag>/<method>_mr_n<n>_res.rds" payloads;
#   2. a mandatory campaign_tag suffix namespaces every campaign (smoke vs
#      calibration vs production), so combine_glob can never pool across them.
campaign_tag <- .env_chr("FS_OR_CAMPAIGN", "c1")
stopifnot(grepl("^[A-Za-z0-9]+$", campaign_tag))
# Design token: or075 / or100 / or150 -- the `design` column of the Stage 3
# extract uses the same three strings.
design_tag <- sprintf("or%03d", as.integer(round(100 * target_or_h)))
# Band tag only when non-default ([MD] :197-200), so the 0.10 default would
# leave a stem untagged; this campaign runs 0.20, hence "_nb20".
nbhd_tag <- if (abs(effect_neighborhood - 0.10) < 1e-12) "" else
              sprintf("_nb%02d", round(100 * effect_neighborhood))
rds_stem <- sprintf("%s_%s_mr_field_%s_n%d%s_%s",
                    method_tag, focus_tag, design_tag, n_sample, nbhd_tag, campaign_tag)
# Results directory: [MD] :209-216's layout (no "_s<n_sims>" piece, so
# seed-disjoint batches of different sizes land in one directory and pool),
# under this design's own root.
results_dir <- file.path("mr_or_harm", sprintf("%s_d%d", rds_stem, mr_draws))
if (identical(run_mode, "batch"))
  dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
sim_id_end    <- sim_id_start + n_sims - 1L
rds_path      <- file.path(results_dir, sprintf("%s_res_%d_%d.rds", rds_stem, sim_id_start, sim_id_end))
combine_glob  <- file.path(results_dir, sprintf("%s_res_*.rds", rds_stem))
combine_files <- NULL    # optional explicit character vector; NULL -> the glob
save_combined <- !identical(.env_chr("FS_OR_SAVE_COMBINED", "TRUE"), "FALSE")
combined_path <- NULL    # NULL -> "<results_dir>/<stem>_combined_<min>_<max>.rds",
                         # deliberately OUTSIDE combine_glob so a re-combine
                         # never re-ingests its own pooled output.

# Refuse to overwrite a git-tracked bundle ([MD] :225-239, verbatim): committed
# bundles are read-only, so no committed study path can be written from here.
.refuse_if_tracked <- function(path) {
  tracked <- tryCatch(
    system2("git", c("ls-files", "--error-unmatch", shQuote(path)),
            stdout = FALSE, stderr = FALSE) == 0L,
    error = function(e) FALSE)
  if (isTRUE(tracked))
    stop("refusing to overwrite the git-tracked bundle '", path,
         "': committed bundles are read-only -- use a new campaign_tag.",
         call. = FALSE)
  invisible(path)
}

# ── Search configuration ([S] :178-207; resample identification) ────────────
consistency_method <- "resample"   # [S] :179; MR requires it on the GLM path
selection_rule      <- .env_chr("FS_OR_RULE", "neighborhood")   # the dispositions'
# What the package already requires (.validate_selection_rule(),
# R/subgroup_consistency_helpers.R:743), checked here so it fails before any
# replicate runs rather than inside every one ([MD] :246-252).
if (!identical(selection_rule, "neighborhood") && !sg_focus %in% .band_foci)
  stop(sprintf("selection_rule = '%s' is accepted only for %s; sg_focus = '%s'.",
               selection_rule, paste(.band_foci, collapse = " / "), sg_focus),
       call. = FALSE)
stop_threshold <- NULL   # [S] :182-191: pinned NULL = scan the full family
or_threshold   <- 0.90   # effect.threshold      ([S] :192; OR scale, > 1 = harm)
or_consistency <- 0.80   # consistency.threshold ([S] :193)
pconsistency   <- 0.90   # ([S] :194)
fs_splits <- 500L; maxk <- 2L; n_min <- 60L; d0_min <- 10L; d1_min <- 10L   # [S] :195
use_lasso <- FALSE; use_dina <- FALSE; use_grf <- FALSE; use_twostage <- TRUE # [S] :196
fs_conf.cont_jcuts <- list(cd40 = 10, wtkg = 10)   # [S] :197, J-quantile grids on the two cut vars
fs_max_subgroups_search <- Inf                     # [S] :198
is_rct <- TRUE; vi_grf_min <- -0.2
# ── Per-identifier arguments ([S] :205-207), consumed only under the matching
# subgroup_method (the method_args switch in the call).
grf_selection        <- "frontier"
grf_select_statistic <- "effect"
grf_depth            <- 2L
dmin.grf             <- 0.0       # [S] :206, the study's literal (DR-score harm floor)
dina_args            <- list()    # [S] :207
dina_select_statistic <- "effect" # [S] :207
adverse_outcome <- TRUE   # [S] :176: analyze y_neg directly; OR > 1 = harm

# ── DGM knobs ([S] :122-171, verbatim; do NOT recalibrate) ──────────────────
n_super     <- 100000L    # [S] :124, the study's fixed 100k universe
sg_quantile <- 0.70       # [S] :126
cont_vars <- c("age", "preanti", "wtkg", "karnof", "cd40", "cd80")   # [S] :158
bin_vars  <- c("hemo", "homo", "drugs", "race", "gender", "symptom") # [S] :159
subgroup_vars <- c("wtkg", "cd40")                                   # [S] :164
subgroup_cuts <- list(                                               # [S] :165-168
  wtkg = list(type = "greater", quantile = sg_quantile),
  cd40 = list(type = "greater", quantile = sg_quantile))
cal_k_inter_range <- c(0.3, 1.5); cal_grid_step <- 0.025             # [S] :222-223
eval_seed <- 20260628L                                               # [S] :341
outcome_type   <- "binary"    # [S] :174
effect_measure <- "OR"        # [S] :175
# Columns emitted by simulate_from_glm_dgm() ([S] :209-213): the outcome IS the
# event on the binary path, so event.name points at the same y_sim.
outcome_name <- "y_sim"; event_name <- "y_sim"; treat_name <- "treat_sim"
id_name <- "id"; harm_col <- "flag_harm"
confounders_base <- c(cont_vars, bin_vars)
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0 || all(is.na(a))) b else a

# ── MR inference controls (mr_inference_args) ───────────────────────────────
# [MD] :309-348: ci_method "field" computes everything the "ij" path computes --
# the debiased element keeps the IJ interval, so the mr_* (IJ) recorder columns
# are what an "ij" run produces -- and additionally returns the field block
# (fit$mr_inference$field), recorded below as fld_H_*.  field_R_out/field_R_in
# are not forwarded by forestsearch(): the package defaults 1000/500 apply.
mr_ci_method    <- .env_chr("FS_OR_CI", "field")
stopifnot(mr_ci_method %in% c("ij", "field"))
mr_t_confirm    <- NULL       # NULL -> the package's near-null default for this measure (OR 1)
mr_confirm_rule <- "point"
mr_field_uniform <- FALSE     # kappa (uniform) calibration: a closed line, off on this design
mr_field_complement <- identical(.env_chr("FS_OR_FIELD_COMPLEMENT", "TRUE"), "TRUE")
# Complement-scale knob (field-s).  DEFAULT "selected": field-s is the
# recommended complement construction, so unset = recommended.
mr_field_scalec <- .env_chr("FS_OR_FIELD_SCALEC", "selected")
stopifnot(mr_field_scalec %in% c("none", "selected"))
mr_ij_residual <- .env_chr("FS_OR_IJ_RESIDUAL", "two_term")
stopifnot(mr_ij_residual %in% c("two_term", "winner", "winner_floor"))
mr_return_reselection <- identical(.env_chr("FS_OR_RESELECTION", "TRUE"), "TRUE")
show_winner_rows <- identical(.env_chr("FS_OR_WINNER_ROWS", "FALSE"), "TRUE")
mr_inference_args <- c(
  list(ci_method = mr_ci_method, draws = mr_draws, include_complement = TRUE,
       confirm_rule = mr_confirm_rule, field_uniform = mr_field_uniform,
       field_complement = mr_field_complement, ij_residual = mr_ij_residual,
       field_scale_complement = mr_field_scalec,
       return_reselection = mr_return_reselection),
  if (!is.null(mr_t_confirm)) list(t_confirm = mr_t_confirm))

# ── FB comparator: never run, never joined on this path ─────────────────────
fb_mode <- "none"   # pinned; there is no committed binary FB bundle to join
run_fb  <- FALSE

cat(sprintf("Batch %d..%d | cell target_or_h=%s n=%d | ci_method=%s complement_field=%s ij_residual=%s reselection=%s scalec=%s | method=%s focus=%s nbhd=%.2f rule=%s | draws=%d | %s x %d workers | campaign=%s\n",
            sim_id_start, sim_id_end, format(target_or_h), n_sample,
            mr_ci_method, mr_field_complement, mr_ij_residual,
            mr_return_reselection, mr_field_scalec, subgroup_method, sg_focus,
            effect_neighborhood, selection_rule, mr_draws, parallel_mode,
            n_workers, campaign_tag))
cat(sprintf("Output stem: %s\nResults dir: %s\n", rds_stem, results_dir))
cat(sprintf("Thresholds (OR scale, > 1 = harm): effect %.2f | consistency %.2f | pconsistency %.2f | n.min %d | d0/d1 %d/%d | maxk %d | splits %d\n",
            or_threshold, or_consistency, pconsistency, n_min, d0_min, d1_min, maxk, fs_splits))
```

# Build the DGM once (n-invariant truth) {#sec-dgm}

The data preparation and the calibration are `[S]` :233–341 verbatim; the only
change is `target_effect = target_or_h` from the knob.

```{r build-dgm}
# ACTG175, prepped exactly as the Section 6.2 application ([S] :233-240): arm 1
# (ZDV+ddI, experimental) vs arm 3 (ddI, control); week-20 "no CD4 improvement".
actg_df <- subset(speff2trial::ACTG175, arms %in% c(1L, 3L))
actg_df$id    <- seq_len(nrow(actg_df))
actg_df$treat <- ifelse(actg_df$arms == 1L, 1L, 0L)            # ZDV+ddI = 1, ddI = 0
actg_df <- actg_df[!is.na(actg_df$cd420), ]                    # drop missing week-20 CD4
actg_df$y_neg <- 1L - as.integer(actg_df$cd420 > actg_df$cd40) # 1 = no improvement (adverse)

# ALT branch ([S] :242-262): build + calibrate to the target harm OR.
# adverse_outcome = FALSE HERE is INTENTIONAL and is the DGM-CONSTRUCTION
# direction, NOT the analysis direction: with the outcome on the adverse y_neg
# scale, a positive interaction shift plants OR(H) > 1 (harm) directly on the
# analysis scale, while the complement inherits the fitted ACTG175 treatment
# effect (~0.66).  The forestsearch() / oracle calls in the recorder run on the
# SAME y_neg scale with adverse_outcome = TRUE (no flip).
dgm <- calibrate_glm_interaction(
  data            = actg_df,
  factor_vars     = bin_vars,
  continuous_vars = cont_vars,
  outcome_var     = "y_neg",
  treatment_var   = "treat",
  target_effect   = target_or_h,          # <- the ONLY knob-driven change
  outcome_type    = "binary",
  effect_measure  = "OR",
  subgroup_vars   = subgroup_vars,
  subgroup_cuts   = subgroup_cuts,
  k_treat         = 1,
  adverse_outcome = FALSE,
  k_inter_range   = cal_k_inter_range,
  grid_step       = cal_grid_step,
  n_super         = n_super,
  seed            = seed_base)

# truth is ASSEMBLED from the DGM object ([S] :263-270), plus the aliases
# fs_mr_oc_summary() reads (R/fs_mr_oc_summary.R:131-190) and the prevalence.
hr <- dgm$hazard_ratios
truth <- list(
  or_causal = hr$AHR         %||% NA_real_,   # overall marginal OR
  marg_H    = hr$AHR_harm    %||% NA_real_,   # theta-dagger  (H)
  marg_Hc   = hr$AHR_no_harm %||% NA_real_,   # theta-dagger  (Hc)
  cde_H     = hr$CDE_harm    %||% NA_real_,   # theta-ddagger (H)
  cde_Hc    = hr$CDE_no_harm %||% NA_real_)   # theta-ddagger (Hc)
truth$effect_Q     <- truth$marg_H            # alias: fs_mr_oc_summary()'s "struct"
truth$effect_Qc    <- truth$marg_Hc
truth$effect_ITT   <- truth$or_causal
truth$prevalence_Q <- dgm$subgroup_info$proportion %||% NA_real_
truth$beta_inter   <- dgm$model_params$beta_inter  %||% NA_real_
truth$target_or_h  <- target_or_h

# fs_dgm_scale() refuses ratio measures (R/fs_dgm_scale.R:130), so there is no
# sampling-scale object on this design; [MD]'s own is.null() guards then skip
# the SCALE CHECK and leave `scale` out of the payload.
dgm_scale <- NULL

cat(sprintf("DGM truth targets [model = %s, target_or_h = %s] (population, shared by every cell):\n",
            dgm_model, format(target_or_h)))
cat(sprintf("  prevalence(H)        : %.2f%%\n", 100 * (truth$prevalence_Q %||% 0)))
cat(sprintf("  k_inter (beta_inter) : %.7f\n", truth$beta_inter))
cat(sprintf("  overall marginal OR  : %.10f\n", truth$or_causal))
cat(sprintf("  theta-dagger  H/Hc   : %.10f / %.10f\n", truth$marg_H, truth$marg_Hc))
cat(sprintf("  theta-ddagger H/Hc   : %.10f / %.10f\n", truth$cde_H,  truth$cde_Hc))
if (is.finite(truth$marg_H) && abs(truth$marg_H / target_or_h - 1) > 1e-6)
  warning(sprintf("calibration missed the target: marg_H %.6f vs target %.6f (k_inter_range [%s]).",
                  truth$marg_H, target_or_h, paste(cal_k_inter_range, collapse = ", ")),
          call. = FALSE)

# beta(Hhat)-OR evaluation frame ([S] :322-341): the ENTIRE super-population,
# each subject once, under the trials' randomized analysis -- the Theorem-2
# conditional target's evaluation population (one fixed universe).
eval_df <- fs_build_eval_frame(dgm, outcome_type = "binary", eval_seed = eval_seed)
for (v in bin_vars)                 # match the recorder's factor->0/1 coercion
  if (v %in% names(eval_df) && is.factor(eval_df[[v]]))  # so rule evaluation on
    eval_df[[v]] <- as.numeric(as.character(eval_df[[v]]))  # the eval frame == trials
.td_chk <- fs_betaHhat_theta_dagger_check(eval_df, outcome_type = "binary",
                                          harm.name = harm_col,
                                          outcome.name = outcome_name,
                                          treat.name = treat_name,
                                          effect_measure = "OR")
cat(sprintf("  beta(Hhat) eval frame: n=%d (FULL super-population, each subject once; eval_seed = %d)\n",
            nrow(eval_df), eval_seed))
cat(sprintf("  theta-dagger check   : %.10f / %.10f  (eval frame at true H/Hc; matches the marginal ORs above)\n",
            .td_chk["thetaDagger_H"], .td_chk["thetaDagger_Hc"]))
```

# Per-replicate machinery {#sec-machinery}

```{r machinery}
# [S] :389-399, verbatim.
.classify <- function(sg_hat, tru) {
  out <- c(sens = NA_real_, spec = NA_real_, ppv = NA_real_, npv = NA_real_)
  if (is.null(sg_hat) || length(sg_hat) != length(tru)) return(out)
  sg_hat <- as.integer(sg_hat); tru <- as.integer(tru)
  tp <- sum(sg_hat==1 & tru==1); fp <- sum(sg_hat==1 & tru==0)
  fn <- sum(sg_hat==0 & tru==1); tn <- sum(sg_hat==0 & tru==0)
  out["sens"] <- if (tp+fn>0) tp/(tp+fn) else NA_real_
  out["spec"] <- if (tn+fp>0) tn/(tn+fp) else NA_real_
  out["ppv"]  <- if (tp+fp>0) tp/(tp+fp) else NA_real_
  out["npv"]  <- if (tn+fn>0) tn/(tn+fn) else NA_real_
  out
}

z95 <- qnorm(0.95); z975 <- qnorm(0.975)

# Oracle: logistic OR + Wald 95% CI on a subset ([S] :360-380, verbatim except
# that the result lands under [MD]'s `or_*` column names).  Guards separation /
# degenerate cells: non-finite coef/SE or a near-constant outcome returns a
# clean NA quadruple, not Inf bounds.  No orientation transform: OR > 1 = harm.
.logit_or_ci <- function(df) {
  na4 <- c(est = NA_real_, lo = NA_real_, hi = NA_real_, se = NA_real_)
  if (!nrow(df) || length(unique(df[[treat_name]])) < 2L) return(na4)
  y <- df[[outcome_name]]
  if (sum(y == 1L) < 5L || sum(y == 0L) < 5L) return(na4)
  fml <- stats::as.formula(sprintf("%s ~ %s", outcome_name, treat_name))
  fit <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(stats::glm(fml, data = df, family = stats::binomial("logit"))),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(na4)
  cf <- stats::coef(fit)
  if (!(treat_name %in% names(cf))) return(na4)
  b <- unname(cf[[treat_name]])
  v <- unname(suppressWarnings(diag(stats::vcov(fit))[treat_name]))
  se <- if (is.finite(v) && v > 0) sqrt(v) else NA_real_
  if (!is.finite(b) || !is.finite(se)) return(na4)
  c(est = exp(b), lo = exp(b - z975 * se), hi = exp(b + z975 * se), se = se)
}

# One record; status distinguishes CONFIG-ERROR / NO-DETECTION / DETECTED.
# Column NAMES and ORDER are [MD] :516-636, unchanged, with two additions named
# in the swap ledger: `seed` (the study's data-level column, a Gate 2 key) and
# the four C_dagger_* / C_ddagger_* target columns (filled post-loop from the
# truth table, beside betaHhat_*).  Every estimator column is on the OR scale
# with OR > 1 = harm, so no orientation bridge is needed anywhere.
.na_record <- function(sim_id) data.frame(
  sim_id = sim_id, seed = NA_integer_, status = NA_character_, detected = NA_integer_,
  mr_ok = NA_integer_, err_msg = NA_character_, mr_msg = NA_character_,
  n_sel = NA_integer_, n_harm = NA_integer_, n_true = NA_integer_,
  sg_def = NA_character_, covs = NA_character_,
  betaHhat_H = NA_real_, betaHhat_Hc = NA_real_,
  C_dagger_H = NA_real_, C_dagger_Hc = NA_real_,
  C_ddagger_H = NA_real_, C_ddagger_Hc = NA_real_,
  fb_secs = NA_real_, fit_mr_secs = NA_real_, fb_err = NA_character_,
  fb_src1 = NA_real_, fb_src2 = NA_real_, fb_nres = NA_integer_,
  or_H_est = NA_real_, or_H_lo = NA_real_, or_H_hi = NA_real_, or_H_se = NA_real_,
  or_Hc_est = NA_real_, or_Hc_lo = NA_real_, or_Hc_hi = NA_real_, or_Hc_se = NA_real_,
  nv_H_est = NA_real_, nv_H_lo = NA_real_, nv_H_hi = NA_real_, nv_H_se = NA_real_,
  nv_Hc_est = NA_real_, nv_Hc_lo = NA_real_, nv_Hc_hi = NA_real_, nv_Hc_se = NA_real_,
  fb_H_est = NA_real_, fb_H_lo = NA_real_, fb_H_hi = NA_real_, fb_H_se = NA_real_,
  fb_Hc_est = NA_real_, fb_Hc_lo = NA_real_, fb_Hc_hi = NA_real_, fb_Hc_se = NA_real_,
  mr_H_est = NA_real_, mr_H_lo = NA_real_, mr_H_hi = NA_real_, mr_H_se_ij = NA_real_,
  mr_Hc_est = NA_real_, mr_Hc_lo = NA_real_, mr_Hc_hi = NA_real_, mr_Hc_se_ij = NA_real_,
  ij_source = NA_character_,
  sens = NA_real_, spec = NA_real_, ppv = NA_real_, npv = NA_real_,
  # ---- [MD]'s template additions, verbatim in naming --------------------------
  label = NA_character_,                                   # gate's selected family label
  mr_harm_flag = NA_integer_,                              # three-valued (NA = MR bailed)
  # MR (field) block, Hhat.  est2 and every bound are ORs.  PRIMARY product:
  # fld_H_lo1s, the one-sided 95% LOWER bound ("harm of at least L").
  fld_H_est2 = NA_real_,
  fld_H_lo2s = NA_real_, fld_H_hi2s = NA_real_,            # two-sided 95% quantile interval
  fld_H_lo1s = NA_real_,                                   # one-sided 95% lower bound (primary)
  fld_H_lo_se = NA_real_, fld_H_hi_se = NA_real_,          # SE-type interval: est2 -+ z * lambda_sd
  fld_H_se = NA_real_,                                     # se_field = lambda_sd
  fld_H_lam_mean = NA_real_,                               # mean Lambda*
  fld_H_q05 = NA_real_, fld_H_q25 = NA_real_, fld_H_q50 = NA_real_,
  fld_H_q75 = NA_real_, fld_H_q95 = NA_real_,
  fld_H_q025 = NA_real_, fld_H_q975 = NA_real_,
  fld_H_nout = NA_integer_, fld_H_nin_mean = NA_real_,     # draw-usage counts
  fld_H_secs = NA_real_,                                   # field block's own wall
  fld_H_note = NA_character_,                              # degenerate-case note
  # Uniform (kappa) calibration block (field_uniform = FALSE here, so all NA).
  fld_H_kappa = NA_real_, fld_H_M = NA_integer_, fld_H_mass = NA_real_,
  fld_H_minC1 = NA_real_, fld_H_lo2u = NA_real_, fld_H_hi2u = NA_real_,
  fld_H_kappa_mcse = NA_real_, fld_H_uniform_secs = NA_real_,
  # Complement field block.  PRIMARY product: fld_Hc_up1s, the one-sided 95%
  # UPPER bound ("harm of at most U").
  fld_Hc_est2 = NA_real_,
  fld_Hc_up1s = NA_real_,
  fld_Hc_lo1s = NA_real_,
  fld_Hc_lo2s = NA_real_, fld_Hc_hi2s = NA_real_,
  fld_Hc_lo_se = NA_real_, fld_Hc_hi_se = NA_real_,
  fld_Hc_se = NA_real_,
  fld_Hc_lam_mean = NA_real_,
  fld_Hc_q05 = NA_real_, fld_Hc_q25 = NA_real_, fld_Hc_q50 = NA_real_,
  fld_Hc_q75 = NA_real_, fld_Hc_q95 = NA_real_,
  fld_Hc_q025 = NA_real_, fld_Hc_q975 = NA_real_,
  fld_Hc_nout = NA_integer_, fld_Hc_nin_mean = NA_real_,
  fld_Hc_nfit = NA_integer_,
  fld_Hc_share_newfit = NA_real_,
  fld_Hc_secs = NA_real_,
  fld_Hc_note = NA_character_,
  # field-s companions (field_scale_complement = "selected"): studentized root,
  # inverted around the same mr_Hc_est.  PRIMARY: fld_Hc_up1s_s.
  fld_Hc_est2_s = NA_real_,
  fld_Hc_up1s_s = NA_real_, fld_Hc_lo1s_s = NA_real_,
  fld_Hc_lo2s_s = NA_real_, fld_Hc_hi2s_s = NA_real_,
  fld_Hc_lo_se_s = NA_real_, fld_Hc_hi_se_s = NA_real_,
  fld_Hc_se_s = NA_real_, fld_Hc_lam_mean_s = NA_real_,
  # Winner-only IJ variants (excluded from tables unless show_winner_rows).
  mr_H_se_w = NA_real_,  mr_H_lo_w = NA_real_,  mr_H_hi_w = NA_real_,
  mr_H_se_wf = NA_real_, mr_H_lo_wf = NA_real_, mr_H_hi_wf = NA_real_,
  mr_Hc_se_w = NA_real_,  mr_Hc_lo_w = NA_real_,  mr_Hc_hi_w = NA_real_,
  mr_Hc_se_wf = NA_real_, mr_Hc_lo_wf = NA_real_, mr_Hc_hi_wf = NA_real_,
  # Joint (H lower, Hc upper) pair from the aligned field draws.
  fld_joint_gamma = NA_real_, fld_joint_prob = NA_real_,
  fld_joint_loH = NA_real_, fld_joint_upHc = NA_real_,
  fld_joint_bonf_loH = NA_real_, fld_joint_bonf_upHc = NA_real_,
  fld_joint_bonf_prob = NA_real_,
  fld_joint_corr = NA_real_, fld_joint_n = NA_integer_,
  # joint_s mirrors (field-s).
  fld_joint_s_gamma = NA_real_, fld_joint_s_prob = NA_real_,
  fld_joint_s_loH = NA_real_, fld_joint_s_upHc = NA_real_,
  fld_joint_s_bonf_loH = NA_real_, fld_joint_s_bonf_upHc = NA_real_,
  fld_joint_s_bonf_prob = NA_real_,
  fld_joint_s_corr = NA_real_, fld_joint_s_n = NA_integer_,
  # Re-selection frequencies (return_reselection = TRUE).
  p_hat_H = NA_real_,
  p_top1 = NA_real_, p_top2 = NA_real_, p_top3 = NA_real_,
  p_lab1 = NA_character_, p_lab2 = NA_character_, p_lab3 = NA_character_,
  # Identifier fields: n_family = the gate's kept family K; n_cons_qual = the
  # consistency-qualifying candidates the identifier sorted; band_n = those
  # within the band on the OBSERVED effects (both structurally NA on GRF and
  # DINA); admitted_n = the forest-/proposal-qualified candidate count;
  # p_hat_sum = sum of p-hat over the family (= selection rate).
  n_family = NA_integer_, n_cons_qual = NA_integer_, band_n = NA_integer_,
  admitted_n = NA_integer_, p_hat_sum = NA_real_,
  # Field re-selection recovery (field_recovery is not passed here -> all NA).
  fld_recov_sens_H = NA_real_, fld_recov_ppv_H = NA_real_,
  fld_recov_sens_Hc = NA_real_, fld_recov_npv_Hc = NA_real_,
  fld_recov_q10 = NA_real_, fld_recov_q50 = NA_real_, fld_recov_q90 = NA_real_,
  fld_recov_share1 = NA_real_, fld_recov_n_used = NA_real_,
  # Warnings raised inside forestsearch(), distinct messages with counts.
  warn_msg = NA_character_,
  # Identification wall inside forestsearch() (60 * minutes_all).
  id_secs = NA_real_,
  # DINA proposal counts (DINA path only; NA elsewhere and on non-detections).
  dina_searched_n = NA_integer_, dina_proposed_n = NA_integer_, dina_tau_min = NA_real_,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

.oracle_or   <- function(df) .logit_or_ci(df[df[[harm_col]] == 1L, , drop = FALSE])
.oracle_or_c <- function(df) .logit_or_ci(df[df[[harm_col]] == 0L, , drop = FALSE])

# rule_covs(): variable names appearing in a realized rule ([S] :438).
rule_covs <- function(rule) forestsearch:::.fs_rule_columns(rule)

# Inner (within-replicate) plan: sequential under "sims" ([MD] :657-659).
inner_parallel <- list(plan = "sequential")

record_replicate <- function(sim_id) {
  rec  <- .na_record(sim_id)
  sd_i <- seed_for(sim_id)              # global-id lookup, not position ([S] :447)
  rec$seed <- sd_i
  # Pin the RNG kind ([S] :449-456): simulate_from_glm_dgm() calls set.seed(seed)
  # with kind = NULL, which KEEPS the ambient kind, so pinning it here makes a
  # replicate the same replicate however it is run.
  RNGkind("L'Ecuyer-CMRG"); set.seed(sd_i)

  df <- tryCatch(simulate_from_glm_dgm(dgm, n = n_sample, seed = sd_i),
                 error = function(e) { rec$err_msg <<- conditionMessage(e); NULL })
  if (is.null(df)) {
    rec$status <- "CONFIG-ERROR"; rec$detected <- NA_integer_; rec$mr_ok <- NA_integer_
    return(rec)
  }
  df[[id_name]] <- seq_len(nrow(df))                                   # [S] :464
  # DINA (and GRF) require NUMERIC covariates, but the DGM builds bin_vars as
  # factors and simulate_from_glm_dgm() carries them as factors.  Coerce them
  # back to 0/1 numeric BEFORE any forestsearch() call ([S] :466-476).
  for (v in bin_vars)
    if (v %in% names(df) && is.factor(df[[v]]))
      df[[v]] <- as.numeric(as.character(df[[v]]))
  confs <- intersect(confounders_base, names(df))                      # [S] :478
  if (k_random_noise > 0) {                                            # [S] :480-487
    noise_names <- paste0("noise", seq_len(k_random_noise))
    set.seed(sd_i + 1000000L)
    for (nm in noise_names) df[[nm]] <- stats::rnorm(nrow(df))
    confs <- c(confs, noise_names)
  }
  rec$n_true <- sum(df[[harm_col]] == 1L, na.rm = TRUE)

  .oH  <- .oracle_or(df);   .oHc <- .oracle_or_c(df)
  rec$or_H_est  <- .oH[["est"]];  rec$or_H_lo  <- .oH[["lo"]]
  rec$or_H_hi   <- .oH[["hi"]];   rec$or_H_se  <- .oH[["se"]]
  rec$or_Hc_est <- .oHc[["est"]]; rec$or_Hc_lo <- .oHc[["lo"]]
  rec$or_Hc_hi  <- .oHc[["hi"]];  rec$or_Hc_se <- .oHc[["se"]]

  t0 <- proc.time()[3]; fs.est <- NULL
  # The call is [S] :489-533's base_args / method_args, with the MR list from
  # [MD] and the three rule arguments from the knobs.
  base_args <- list(
    df.analysis     = df,
    outcome.name    = outcome_name, event.name = event_name,
    treat.name      = treat_name,   id.name    = id_name,
    flag_harm.name  = harm_col,     confounders.name = confs,
    is.RCT          = is_rct,       seedit = sd_i,
    quiet           = FALSE,
    outcome_type    = outcome_type, effect_measure = effect_measure,
    adverse_outcome = adverse_outcome,
    sg_focus        = sg_focus,
    subgroup_method = subgroup_method,
    effect.threshold       = or_threshold,
    consistency.threshold  = or_consistency,
    pconsistency.threshold = pconsistency, n.min = n_min,
    d0.min = d0_min, d1.min = d1_min, maxk = maxk,
    selection_rule  = selection_rule, effect_neighborhood = effect_neighborhood,
    stop_threshold  = stop_threshold,
    conf.cont_jcuts = fs_conf.cont_jcuts,
    max_subgroups_search = fs_max_subgroups_search,
    parallel_args   = inner_parallel,
    details         = FALSE,
    mr_inference     = TRUE,
    mr_inference_args = mr_inference_args)
  method_args <- switch(
    subgroup_method,
    consistency = list(
      consistency_method = consistency_method,
      use_lasso = use_lasso, use_grf = use_grf, use_twostage = use_twostage,
      use_dina = use_dina, fs.splits = fs_splits,
      vi.grf.min = vi_grf_min),
    dina = list(dina_select_statistic = dina_select_statistic,
                dina_args             = dina_args),
    grf  = list(grf_selection = grf_selection, grf_depth = grf_depth,
                dmin.grf = dmin.grf, grf_select_statistic = grf_select_statistic),
    stop("unknown subgroup_method: ", subgroup_method))

  # BOTH streams are captured ([S] :539-548) and warnings are CAPTURED, not
  # suppressed ([MD] :1070-1076): each distinct message with its count lands in
  # warn_msg, so a factor-comparison warning can never pass unseen.
  .warns <- character(0); outs <- character(0)
  msgs <- tryCatch(
    utils::capture.output(
      outs <- utils::capture.output(
        fs.est <- withCallingHandlers(do.call(forestsearch, c(base_args, method_args)),
          warning = function(w) { .warns <<- c(.warns, conditionMessage(w)); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") }),
        type = "output"),
      type = "message"),
    error = function(e) {
      if (isTRUE(diag_mode)) warning(sprintf("FS-ERR sim %d: %s", sim_id, conditionMessage(e)))
      rec$err_msg <<- conditionMessage(e); character(0) })
  rec$fit_mr_secs <- proc.time()[3] - t0
  if (length(.warns)) { .tw <- table(.warns)
    rec$warn_msg <- paste(sprintf("%s [x%d]", names(.tw), as.integer(.tw)), collapse = " | ") }
  if (!is.null(fs.est) && is.numeric(fs.est$minutes_all)) rec$id_secs <- 60 * fs.est$minutes_all
  # Diagnostic MR lines only; the routine per-replicate lines are DROPPED ([S] :551-557).
  mr_all  <- grep("multiplier resampling|mr_inference|MR harm", c(msgs, outs), value = TRUE)
  mr_keep <- mr_all[!grepl("constructing de-biased estimates|MR harm confirmation", mr_all)]
  if (length(mr_keep)) rec$mr_msg <- paste(mr_keep, collapse = " | ")

  if (!is.na(rec$err_msg) || is.null(fs.est)) {
    rec$status <- "CONFIG-ERROR"; rec$detected <- NA_integer_; rec$mr_ok <- NA_integer_
    return(rec)
  }
  # admitted_n, recorded HERE -- before the no-detection return -- because an
  # empty admitted set is written as 0L and is exactly the reason that replicate
  # did not detect ([MD] :1083-1090).  GRF path only.
  .adm <- if (identical(subgroup_method, "grf")) fs.est$grf_res$admitted_n else NULL
  if (!is.null(.adm) && length(.adm) >= 1L && is.finite(.adm[1]))
    rec$admitted_n <- as.integer(.adm[1])
  # DINA path only ([MD] :1091-1105): the proposal and admission counts from
  # DINA's own selection object, which exists only when DINA selected.
  .dsg <- if (identical(subgroup_method, "dina")) fs.est$grp.consistency$out_sg else NULL
  if (is.list(.dsg)) {
    if (length(.dsg$admitted_n) && is.finite(.dsg$admitted_n[1]))
      rec$admitted_n <- as.integer(.dsg$admitted_n[1])
    rec$dina_searched_n <- as.integer(.dsg$n_candidates_searched %||% NA_integer_)
    rec$dina_proposed_n <- as.integer(.dsg$n_candidates_qualifying %||% NA_integer_)
    if (is.data.frame(.dsg$candidates) && nrow(.dsg$candidates) && "tau_hat" %in% names(.dsg$candidates))
      rec$dina_tau_min <- min(as.numeric(.dsg$candidates$tau_hat))
  }
  found <- !is.null(fs.est$sg.harm) && length(fs.est$sg.harm) > 0 &&
           !all(is.na(fs.est$sg.harm))                                  # [S] :571-572
  if (!found) { rec$status <- "NO-DETECTION"; rec$detected <- 0L; return(rec) }
  rec$status <- "DETECTED"; rec$detected <- 1L
  # Consistency-qualifying candidates and the observed-effect band ([MD] :1112-1122).
  ctab <- fs.est$grp.consistency$out_sg$result
  if (is.data.frame(ctab) && all(c("hr", "N") %in% names(ctab)) && nrow(ctab)) {
    rec$n_cons_qual <- nrow(ctab)
    hr_c <- as.numeric(ctab$hr)
    if (any(is.finite(hr_c)))
      rec$band_n <- sum(is.finite(hr_c) &
                        hr_c >= (1 - effect_neighborhood) * max(hr_c, na.rm = TRUE))
  }
  rec$sg_def <- paste(fs.est$sg.harm, collapse = " & ")                 # the key fs_attach_betaHhat() joins on
  rec$covs   <- paste(rule_covs(fs.est$sg.harm), collapse = "+")        # [S] :575

  sgv <- fs.est$grp.consistency$sg.harm.id
  if (!is.null(sgv) && length(sgv) == nrow(df)) {
    rec$n_harm <- sum(sgv == 1L, na.rm = TRUE)
    rec[c("sens","spec","ppv","npv")] <- as.list(.classify(sgv, df[[harm_col]]))
  }

  g <- fs.est$mr_inference
  rec$mr_ok <- as.integer(!is.null(g))
  if (!is.null(g)) {
    rec$n_sel     <- g$n_selected %||% NA_integer_
    rec$n_family  <- g$n_family   %||% NA_integer_
    rec$ij_source <- g$debiased$ij_source %||% NA_character_
    rec$nv_H_est <- g$naive$est    %||% NA_real_
    rec$nv_H_lo  <- g$naive$lower  %||% NA_real_
    rec$nv_H_hi  <- g$naive$upper  %||% NA_real_
    rec$nv_H_se  <- g$debiased$se_wald %||% NA_real_
    rec$mr_H_est <- g$debiased$est   %||% NA_real_
    rec$mr_H_lo  <- g$debiased$lower %||% NA_real_
    rec$mr_H_hi  <- g$debiased$upper %||% NA_real_
    rec$mr_H_se_ij <- g$debiased$se_ij %||% NA_real_
    if (is.list(g$complement) && !is.null(g$complement$debiased)) {
      rec$nv_Hc_est   <- g$complement$naive$est    %||% NA_real_
      rec$nv_Hc_lo    <- g$complement$naive$lower  %||% NA_real_
      rec$nv_Hc_hi    <- g$complement$naive$upper  %||% NA_real_
      rec$nv_Hc_se    <- g$complement$debiased$se_wald %||% NA_real_
      rec$mr_Hc_est   <- g$complement$debiased$est   %||% NA_real_
      rec$mr_Hc_lo    <- g$complement$debiased$lower %||% NA_real_
      rec$mr_Hc_hi    <- g$complement$debiased$upper %||% NA_real_
      rec$mr_Hc_se_ij <- g$complement$debiased$se_ij %||% NA_real_
    }
    rec$label <- g$selected_label %||% NA_character_
    # THREE-VALUED: NA when MR ran but bailed before a decision.
    rec$mr_harm_flag <- if (is.null(g$harm_flag) || is.na(g$harm_flag))
      NA_integer_ else as.integer(isTRUE(g$harm_flag))
    rec$mr_H_se_w  <- g$debiased$se_ij_winner %||% NA_real_
    rec$mr_H_lo_w  <- g$debiased$lower_w %||% NA_real_
    rec$mr_H_hi_w  <- g$debiased$upper_w %||% NA_real_
    rec$mr_H_se_wf <- g$debiased$se_ij_winner_floor %||% NA_real_
    rec$mr_H_lo_wf <- g$debiased$lower_wf %||% NA_real_
    rec$mr_H_hi_wf <- g$debiased$upper_wf %||% NA_real_
    if (is.list(g$complement) && !is.null(g$complement$debiased)) {
      rec$mr_Hc_se_w  <- g$complement$debiased$se_ij_winner %||% NA_real_
      rec$mr_Hc_lo_w  <- g$complement$debiased$lower_w %||% NA_real_
      rec$mr_Hc_hi_w  <- g$complement$debiased$upper_w %||% NA_real_
      rec$mr_Hc_se_wf <- g$complement$debiased$se_ij_winner_floor %||% NA_real_
      rec$mr_Hc_lo_wf <- g$complement$debiased$lower_wf %||% NA_real_
      rec$mr_Hc_hi_wf <- g$complement$debiased$upper_wf %||% NA_real_
    }
    # ---- MR (field) block (ci_method = "field") ----
    if (is.list(g$field)) {
      f <- g$field
      rec$fld_H_note <- f$note %||% NA_character_
      if (is.null(f$note)) {
        rec$fld_H_est2     <- f$est2
        rec$fld_H_lo2s     <- f$lower_2s;  rec$fld_H_hi2s <- f$upper_2s
        rec$fld_H_lo1s     <- f$lower_1s
        rec$fld_H_lo_se    <- f$lower_se;  rec$fld_H_hi_se <- f$upper_se
        rec$fld_H_se       <- f$se_field
        rec$fld_H_lam_mean <- f$lambda_mean
        rec$fld_H_q05  <- f$q05;  rec$fld_H_q25  <- f$q25;  rec$fld_H_q50 <- f$q50
        rec$fld_H_q75  <- f$q75;  rec$fld_H_q95  <- f$q95
        rec$fld_H_q025 <- f$q025; rec$fld_H_q975 <- f$q975
        rec$fld_H_nin_mean <- f$n_in_used_mean
        rec$fld_H_secs     <- f$timing_seconds %||% NA_real_
        if (is.list(f$uniform) && is.null(f$uniform$note)) {
          u <- f$uniform
          rec$fld_H_kappa        <- u$kappa
          rec$fld_H_M            <- u$M
          rec$fld_H_mass         <- u$mass_covered
          rec$fld_H_minC1        <- u$minC1
          rec$fld_H_lo2u         <- u$lower_2u
          rec$fld_H_hi2u         <- u$upper_2u
          rec$fld_H_kappa_mcse   <- u$kappa_mcse
          rec$fld_H_uniform_secs <- u$timing_seconds
        }
      }
      rec$fld_H_nout <- f$n_out_used %||% NA_integer_
      if (is.list(f$complement)) {
        fc <- f$complement
        rec$fld_Hc_note <- fc$note %||% NA_character_
        if (is.null(fc$note)) {
          rec$fld_Hc_est2     <- fc$est2
          rec$fld_Hc_up1s     <- fc$upper_1s
          rec$fld_Hc_lo1s     <- fc$lower_1s
          rec$fld_Hc_lo2s     <- fc$lower_2s;  rec$fld_Hc_hi2s <- fc$upper_2s
          rec$fld_Hc_lo_se    <- fc$lower_se;  rec$fld_Hc_hi_se <- fc$upper_se
          rec$fld_Hc_se       <- fc$se_field
          rec$fld_Hc_lam_mean <- fc$lambda_mean
          rec$fld_Hc_q05  <- fc$q05;  rec$fld_Hc_q25  <- fc$q25;  rec$fld_Hc_q50 <- fc$q50
          rec$fld_Hc_q75  <- fc$q75;  rec$fld_Hc_q95  <- fc$q95
          rec$fld_Hc_q025 <- fc$q025; rec$fld_Hc_q975 <- fc$q975
          rec$fld_Hc_nin_mean <- fc$n_in_used_mean
          rec$fld_Hc_secs     <- fc$timing_seconds %||% NA_real_
          rec$fld_Hc_est2_s     <- fc$est2_s      %||% NA_real_
          rec$fld_Hc_up1s_s     <- fc$upper_1s_s  %||% NA_real_
          rec$fld_Hc_lo1s_s     <- fc$lower_1s_s  %||% NA_real_
          rec$fld_Hc_lo2s_s     <- fc$lower_2s_s  %||% NA_real_
          rec$fld_Hc_hi2s_s     <- fc$upper_2s_s  %||% NA_real_
          rec$fld_Hc_lo_se_s    <- fc$lower_se_s  %||% NA_real_
          rec$fld_Hc_hi_se_s    <- fc$upper_se_s  %||% NA_real_
          rec$fld_Hc_se_s       <- fc$se_field_s  %||% NA_real_
          rec$fld_Hc_lam_mean_s <- fc$lambda_mean_s %||% NA_real_
        }
        rec$fld_Hc_nout         <- fc$n_out_used %||% NA_integer_
        rec$fld_Hc_nfit         <- fc$n_complement_fits %||% NA_integer_
        rec$fld_Hc_share_newfit <- fc$share_draws_new_fit %||% NA_real_
      }
      if (is.list(f$recovery)) {
        fr <- f$recovery
        rec$fld_recov_sens_H  <- fr$sens_H  %||% NA_real_
        rec$fld_recov_ppv_H   <- fr$ppv_H   %||% NA_real_
        rec$fld_recov_sens_Hc <- fr$sens_Hc %||% NA_real_
        rec$fld_recov_npv_Hc  <- fr$npv_Hc  %||% NA_real_
        rec$fld_recov_q10     <- fr$q10     %||% NA_real_
        rec$fld_recov_q50     <- fr$q50     %||% NA_real_
        rec$fld_recov_q90     <- fr$q90     %||% NA_real_
        rec$fld_recov_share1  <- fr$share_equal_1 %||% NA_real_
        rec$fld_recov_n_used  <- fr$n_used  %||% NA_real_
      }
      if (is.list(f$joint) && is.null(f$joint$note)) {
        jj <- f$joint
        rec$fld_joint_gamma     <- jj$gamma
        rec$fld_joint_prob      <- jj$joint_prob
        rec$fld_joint_loH       <- jj$lower_H
        rec$fld_joint_upHc      <- jj$upper_Hc
        rec$fld_joint_bonf_loH  <- jj$bonf_lower_H
        rec$fld_joint_bonf_upHc <- jj$bonf_upper_Hc
        rec$fld_joint_bonf_prob <- jj$bonf_joint_prob
        rec$fld_joint_corr      <- jj$corr
        rec$fld_joint_n         <- as.integer(jj$n_joint_draws)
      }
      if (is.list(f$joint_s) && is.null(f$joint_s$note)) {
        js <- f$joint_s
        rec$fld_joint_s_gamma     <- js$gamma
        rec$fld_joint_s_prob      <- js$joint_prob
        rec$fld_joint_s_loH       <- js$lower_H
        rec$fld_joint_s_upHc      <- js$upper_Hc
        rec$fld_joint_s_bonf_loH  <- js$bonf_lower_H
        rec$fld_joint_s_bonf_upHc <- js$bonf_upper_Hc
        rec$fld_joint_s_bonf_prob <- js$bonf_joint_prob
        rec$fld_joint_s_corr      <- js$corr
        rec$fld_joint_s_n         <- as.integer(js$n_joint_draws)
      }
    }
    if (is.list(g$reselection) && !is.null(g$reselection$p_hat) &&
        is.finite(g$selected_index %||% NA_integer_)) {
      ph <- g$reselection$p_hat
      rec$p_hat_H   <- unname(ph[g$selected_index])
      rec$p_hat_sum <- sum(ph, na.rm = TRUE)
      o  <- order(ph, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(min(3L, length(ph)))]
      tv <- unname(ph[o]); tl <- names(ph)[o]
      rec$p_top1 <- tv[1]; rec$p_lab1 <- tl[1]
      if (length(o) >= 2L) { rec$p_top2 <- tv[2]; rec$p_lab2 <- tl[2] }
      if (length(o) >= 3L) { rec$p_top3 <- tv[3]; rec$p_lab3 <- tl[3] }
    }
  }
  rec
}

# Replicate-level error firewall ([MD] :967-976, [S] :636-652): a setup mistake
# escaping record_replicate() is kept as a CONFIG-ERROR row WITH its message, so
# a configuration failure can never read as a scientific null.
.safe_record <- function(s) {
  tryCatch(record_replicate(s), error = function(e) {
    rec <- .na_record(s); rec$err_msg <- conditionMessage(e)
    rec$status <- "CONFIG-ERROR"; rec$detected <- NA_integer_; rec$mr_ok <- NA_integer_
    rec
  })
}
```

# Run the batch {#sec-run}

```{r run-batch}
#| message: false
# run_mode = "batch" runs and saves ONE seed-disjoint piece; run_mode =
# "combine" runs nothing and merges the pieces already on disk ([MD] :980-1233).
elapsed <- NA_real_

if (identical(run_mode, "batch")) {

sim_ids <- seq(sim_id_start, length.out = if (isTRUE(diag_mode)) 5L else n_sims)
t_all <- proc.time()[3]
registerDoFuture(); future::plan(future::multisession, workers = n_workers)
results <- foreach(i = sim_ids, .combine = rbind,
                   .options.future = list(packages = c("forestsearch", "data.table"),
                                          seed = TRUE)) %dofuture%
  .safe_record(i)
future::plan(future::sequential)
elapsed <- proc.time()[3] - t_all   # run-loop wall-clock, for the timing section

# ---- Guard: the run loop must have produced a usable results frame ----------
if (!is.data.frame(results) || !nrow(results))
  stop(sprintf("run loop produced no usable records for sim_id %d-%d.",
               min(sim_ids), max(sim_ids)), call. = FALSE)
.cfg_err <- unique(stats::na.omit(results$err_msg))
if (length(.cfg_err) && all(!is.na(results$err_msg)))
  stop("CONFIG ERROR -- every replicate failed before any search ran.\n",
       "Distinct message(s):\n", paste0("  - ", .cfg_err, collapse = "\n"), call. = FALSE)
if (length(.cfg_err))
  warning(sprintf("%d of %d replicate(s) failed: %s", sum(!is.na(results$err_msg)),
                  nrow(results), paste(.cfg_err, collapse = " | ")), call. = FALSE)

# ---- INVARIANT: every interval must satisfy lo <= hi ([MD] :1009-1042) ------
.ci_check <- function(r) {
  bad <- character(0)
  for (k in c("or","nv","fb","mr")) for (sfx in c("H","Hc")) {
    lo <- r[[paste0(k, "_", sfx, "_lo")]]; hi <- r[[paste0(k, "_", sfx, "_hi")]]
    if (is.null(lo) || is.null(hi)) next
    ok <- is.finite(lo) & is.finite(hi)
    if (any(ok & hi < lo))
      bad <- c(bad, sprintf("%s_%s (%d of %d rows inverted)", k, sfx,
                            sum(ok & hi < lo), sum(ok)))
  }
  for (pr in list(c("fld_H_lo2s", "fld_H_hi2s"), c("fld_H_lo_se", "fld_H_hi_se"),
                  c("fld_H_lo2u", "fld_H_hi2u"),
                  c("fld_Hc_lo2s", "fld_Hc_hi2s"), c("fld_Hc_lo_se", "fld_Hc_hi_se"),
                  c("fld_Hc_lo1s", "fld_Hc_up1s"),
                  c("fld_Hc_lo2s_s", "fld_Hc_hi2s_s"), c("fld_Hc_lo_se_s", "fld_Hc_hi_se_s"),
                  c("fld_Hc_lo1s_s", "fld_Hc_up1s_s"),
                  c("mr_H_lo_w", "mr_H_hi_w"), c("mr_H_lo_wf", "mr_H_hi_wf"),
                  c("mr_Hc_lo_w", "mr_Hc_hi_w"), c("mr_Hc_lo_wf", "mr_Hc_hi_wf"))) {
    lo <- r[[pr[1]]]; hi <- r[[pr[2]]]
    if (is.null(lo) || is.null(hi)) next
    ok <- is.finite(lo) & is.finite(hi)
    if (any(ok & hi < lo))
      bad <- c(bad, sprintf("%s/%s (%d of %d rows inverted)", pr[1], pr[2],
                            sum(ok & hi < lo), sum(ok)))
  }
  if (length(bad))
    stop("interval invariant violated -- hi < lo for: ", paste(bad, collapse = "; "),
         call. = FALSE)
  invisible(TRUE)
}
.ci_check(results)

# ---- INVARIANT: the OR scale, with degenerate logistic fits accounted for ----
# The OR-scale counterpart of [MD]'s identity-scale checks, and §1.5(d)'s positivity
# assertion, run here so a render fails before it saves.  It is split in two, because a
# bound and an estimate fail differently on this scale.
#
# ESTIMATES must be strictly positive: a non-positive odds ratio is a corrupted value.
#
# BOUNDS are exponentials of a Wald or quantile interval on the log-OR scale.  Under
# COMPLETE SEPARATION in an arm the logistic MLE diverges -- the study's .logit_or_ci()
# guards only the OVERALL >= 5 events and >= 5 non-events ([S] :366-368), so a subset whose
# TREATED arm is all-event still fits -- and the reported beta-hat and SE blow up together
# (e.g. beta 20.38, SE 2608 on a 43-subject true region).  exp() then underflows the lower
# bound to 0 and overflows the upper to Inf.  Mathematically the bound is still positive;
# it is the double that cannot hold it.  So a bound is fatal only when NEGATIVE, while
# zero / infinite bounds are COUNTED and REPORTED as degenerate-fit diagnostics.  The
# committed study records exactly the same values and drops such rows from coverage through
# its is.finite(lo) & is.finite(hi) masks; this template keeps the recipe verbatim and makes
# the count visible instead of silent.
.pos_est <- c("or_H_est","or_Hc_est","nv_H_est","nv_Hc_est","mr_H_est","mr_Hc_est",
              "fld_H_est2","fld_Hc_est2","fld_Hc_est2_s","betaHhat_H","betaHhat_Hc")
.pos_bnd <- c("or_H_lo","or_H_hi","or_Hc_lo","or_Hc_hi",
              "nv_H_lo","nv_H_hi","nv_Hc_lo","nv_Hc_hi",
              "mr_H_lo","mr_H_hi","mr_Hc_lo","mr_Hc_hi",
              "fld_H_lo1s","fld_H_lo2s","fld_H_hi2s",
              "fld_Hc_up1s","fld_Hc_lo1s","fld_Hc_lo2s","fld_Hc_hi2s",
              "fld_Hc_up1s_s","fld_Hc_lo1s_s","fld_Hc_lo2s_s","fld_Hc_hi2s_s",
              "fld_Hc_lo_se_s","fld_Hc_hi_se_s","fld_Hc_lo_se","fld_Hc_hi_se","fld_H_lo_se","fld_H_hi_se",
              "fld_joint_loH","fld_joint_upHc","fld_joint_bonf_loH","fld_joint_bonf_upHc",
              "fld_joint_s_loH","fld_joint_s_upHc","fld_joint_s_bonf_loH","fld_joint_s_bonf_upHc")
.bad_est <- vapply(intersect(.pos_est, names(results)), function(k) {
  x <- results[[k]]; sum(is.finite(x) & x <= 0) }, integer(1))
if (any(.bad_est > 0L))
  stop("OR positivity violated -- non-positive finite ESTIMATE in: ",
       paste(sprintf("%s (%d)", names(.bad_est)[.bad_est > 0L], .bad_est[.bad_est > 0L]),
             collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
.neg_bnd <- vapply(intersect(.pos_bnd, names(results)), function(k) {
  x <- results[[k]]; sum(is.finite(x) & x < 0) }, integer(1))
if (any(.neg_bnd > 0L))
  stop("OR scale violated -- NEGATIVE bound in: ",
       paste(sprintf("%s (%d)", names(.neg_bnd)[.neg_bnd > 0L], .neg_bnd[.neg_bnd > 0L]),
             collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
.deg <- vapply(intersect(.pos_bnd, names(results)), function(k) {
  x <- results[[k]]; sum((is.finite(x) & x == 0) | is.infinite(x)) }, integer(1))
.deg_or <- sum(is.finite(results$or_H_est) & (!is.finite(results$or_H_hi) | results$or_H_lo == 0), na.rm = TRUE) +
           sum(is.finite(results$or_Hc_est) & (!is.finite(results$or_Hc_hi) | results$or_Hc_lo == 0), na.rm = TRUE)
if (any(.deg > 0L))
  cat(sprintf("DEGENERATE BOUNDS (separation; bound underflowed to 0 or overflowed to Inf): %s | oracle rows affected: %d of %d. Recorded as the study records them; excluded from coverage by the finiteness masks downstream.\n",
              paste(sprintf("%s %d", names(.deg)[.deg > 0L], .deg[.deg > 0L]), collapse = ", "),
              .deg_or, nrow(results))) else
  cat("DEGENERATE BOUNDS: none.\n")

# Exact beta(Hhat) at the realized rules, on the fixed evaluation frame ([S]
# :697-707): a post-loop, whole-frame call keyed on sg_def.  Undetected and
# CONFIG-ERROR rows take the no-subgroup record, so they remain part of the
# Hhat^c denominator.
results <- forestsearch::fs_attach_betaHhat(
  results, eval_df, focus = "harm", outcome_type = "binary",
  effect_measure = "OR",
  outcome.name = outcome_name, event.name = event_name,
  treat.name = treat_name)

# The study's two population references, recorded per replicate beside
# betaHhat_* (task §1.3): theta-dagger (marginal OR) and theta-ddagger (CDE).
results$C_dagger_H   <- truth$marg_H
results$C_dagger_Hc  <- truth$marg_Hc
results$C_ddagger_H  <- truth$cde_H
results$C_ddagger_Hc <- truth$cde_Hc

cat(sprintf("Batch sim_id %d-%d: %d/%d detections in %.1f s (%.1f s/replicate; %d workers).\n",
            min(sim_ids), max(sim_ids), sum(results$detected, na.rm = TRUE),
            length(sim_ids), elapsed, elapsed / max(1L, length(sim_ids)), n_workers))

out <- rds_path
.payload <- list(results = results, truth = truth,
  meta = list(n_sample = n_sample, n_sims = length(sim_ids),
              nb_boots = nb_boots, mr_draws = mr_draws,
              sg_focus = sg_focus, focus_tag = focus_tag,
              selection_rule = selection_rule,
              effect_neighborhood = effect_neighborhood,
              consistency_method = consistency_method,
              subgroup_method = subgroup_method,
              # the identifiers' own arguments (poolability keys)
              dmin_grf = dmin.grf, grf_selection = grf_selection,
              grf_depth = grf_depth, grf_select_statistic = grf_select_statistic,
              dina_select_statistic = dina_select_statistic,
              dina_args = paste(deparse(dina_args), collapse = ""),
              # --- the design ([S] :716-741) -------------------------------
              outcome_type = outcome_type, effect_measure = effect_measure,
              adverse_outcome = adverse_outcome, focus = "harm",
              dgm_model = dgm_model, target_or_h = target_or_h,
              design_tag = design_tag,
              sg_quantile = sg_quantile, n_super = n_super,
              k_random_noise = k_random_noise,
              effect_threshold = or_threshold,
              consistency_threshold = or_consistency,
              pconsistency = pconsistency,
              stop_threshold = paste(deparse(stop_threshold), collapse = " "),
              # --- the truths, carried in meta as poolability keys ---------
              truth_or_causal = truth$or_causal,
              truth_marg_H = truth$marg_H, truth_marg_Hc = truth$marg_Hc,
              truth_cde_H = truth$cde_H,   truth_cde_Hc = truth$cde_Hc,
              truth_prevalence_Q = truth$prevalence_Q,
              truth_beta_inter = truth$beta_inter,
              eval_seed = eval_seed, seed_scheme = seed_scheme,
              seed_base = seed_base, sim_id_start = sim_id_start,
              sim_id_end = sim_id_end,
              parallel_mode = parallel_mode, n_workers = n_workers,
              # --- template provenance (mr_field) --------------------------
              ci_method = mr_ci_method,
              field_uniform = mr_field_uniform,
              field_complement = mr_field_complement,
              ij_residual = mr_ij_residual,
              return_reselection = mr_return_reselection,
              field_scale_complement = mr_field_scalec,
              field_R = "R_out=1000/R_in=500 (package defaults; not forwarded by forestsearch())",
              fb_mode = fb_mode,
              campaign_tag = campaign_tag,
              pkg_version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("forestsearch")),
              pkg_commit = tryCatch(system("git rev-parse --short HEAD", intern = TRUE)[1],
                                    error = function(e) NA_character_),
              r_version = as.character(getRversion()),
              hostname = unname(Sys.info()[["nodename"]]),
              built_at = Sys.time()))
if (!is.null(dgm_scale)) .payload$scale <- dgm_scale
.payload$oc <- tryCatch(fs_mr_oc_summary(.payload),
                        error = function(e) { warning("fs_mr_oc_summary() failed: ",
                          conditionMessage(e), call. = FALSE); NULL })
.refuse_if_tracked(out)
saveRDS(.payload[intersect(c("results", "truth", "scale", "oc", "meta"),
                           names(.payload))], out)
cat(sprintf("Saved batch bundle (%d rows, sim_id %d-%d) to %s\n",
            nrow(results), min(sim_ids), max(sim_ids), out))

} else if (identical(run_mode, "combine")) {
  # ---- Merge seed-disjoint batches ([MD] :1177-1233) ----------------------
  files <- if (!is.null(combine_files)) combine_files else Sys.glob(combine_glob)
  files <- files[file.exists(files)]
  if (!length(files))
    stop("combine mode: no batch files found (combine_glob = '",
         combine_glob, "').", call. = FALSE)
  bundles <- lapply(files, readRDS)

  # Count-invariant meta MUST agree across batches to pool them; the template
  # provenance keys join the gate so batches from a different campaign,
  # ci_method, design point or complement setting never silently pool.
  .meta_get <- function(b, k) b$meta[[k]] %||% NA
  for (k in c("n_sample", "nb_boots", "mr_draws", "subgroup_method",
              "sg_focus", "target_or_h", "design_tag", "dgm_model", "seed_base",
              "k_random_noise", "ci_method", "campaign_tag", "field_complement",
              "ij_residual", "effect_threshold", "consistency_threshold",
              "pconsistency", "effect_neighborhood", "selection_rule",
              "field_scale_complement", "sg_quantile", "n_super", "eval_seed",
              "seed_scheme", "adverse_outcome", "outcome_type", "effect_measure",
              "truth_marg_H", "truth_marg_Hc", "truth_cde_H", "truth_cde_Hc",
              "dmin_grf", "grf_selection", "grf_depth", "grf_select_statistic",
              "dina_select_statistic", "dina_args")) {
    vals <- unique(lapply(bundles, .meta_get, k = k))
    if (length(vals) > 1L)
      stop(sprintf("combine mode: batches disagree on meta$%s (%s).",
                   k, paste(unlist(vals), collapse = ", ")), call. = FALSE)
  }

  truths <- lapply(bundles, `[[`, "truth")
  if (length(truths) > 1L &&
      !all(vapply(truths[-1], identical, logical(1), truths[[1]])))
    warning("combine mode: truth targets differ across batches; using the first.",
            call. = FALSE)
  truth <- truths[[1]]

  nms <- lapply(bundles, function(b) names(b$results))
  if (length(unique(nms)) > 1L) {
    ref <- nms[[1]]
    bad <- which(!vapply(nms, identical, logical(1), ref))
    stop(sprintf("combine mode: batch files have different column sets; %s differ(s) from %s.\n  Missing here: %s",
                 paste(basename(files)[bad], collapse = ", "), basename(files)[1],
                 paste(setdiff(ref, nms[[bad[1]]]), collapse = ", ")), call. = FALSE)
  }

  results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(bundles, `[[`, "results"))
  dup <- unique(results$sim_id[duplicated(results$sim_id)])
  if (length(dup))
    stop(sprintf("combine mode: %d duplicated sim_id across batches (e.g. %s); the seed ranges overlap, so the pool is NOT independent.",
                 length(dup), paste(utils::head(sort(dup), 5L), collapse = ", ")),
         call. = FALSE)

  n_sample <- bundles[[1]]$meta$n_sample %||% n_sample
  mr_draws <- bundles[[1]]$meta$mr_draws %||% mr_draws
  sim_ids  <- sort(results$sim_id)
  n_sims   <- length(sim_ids)
  elapsed  <- NA_real_

  rng <- range(results$sim_id)
  cat(sprintf("Combined %d batch file(s) -> %d rows, sim_id %d-%d.\n",
              length(files), nrow(results), rng[1], rng[2]))
  cat("  files: ", paste(basename(files), collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")

  if (isTRUE(save_combined)) {
    cpath <- combined_path %||%
      file.path(results_dir, sprintf("%s_combined_%d_%d.rds", rds_stem, rng[1], rng[2]))
    .m1 <- bundles[[1]]$meta
    .cpayload <- list(results = results, truth = truth,
      meta = c(.m1[setdiff(names(.m1), c("n_sims", "sim_id_start", "sim_id_end",
                                          "n_workers", "built_at"))],
               list(n_sims = n_sims, sim_id_start = rng[1], sim_id_end = rng[2],
                    n_batches = length(files), source_files = basename(files),
                    n_workers_by_batch = vapply(bundles, function(b) as.integer(b$meta$n_workers %||% NA_integer_), integer(1)),
                    built_at = Sys.time())))
    if (!is.null(dgm_scale)) .cpayload$scale <- dgm_scale
    .cpayload$oc <- tryCatch(fs_mr_oc_summary(.cpayload),
                             error = function(e) NULL)
    .refuse_if_tracked(cpath)
    saveRDS(.cpayload[intersect(c("results", "truth", "scale", "oc", "meta"),
                                names(.cpayload))], cpath)
    cat(sprintf("Saved pooled bundle (%d rows, %d batches) to %s\n",
                nrow(results), length(files), cpath))
  }

} else {
  stop("run_mode must be \"batch\" or \"combine\"; got \"", run_mode, "\".",
       call. = FALSE)
}
```

# Summary layer {#sec-summary}

Mirrored from `[MD]` :1235–2019, adapted to the **odds-ratio** scale: no
orientation bridge (`adverse_outcome = TRUE`, so OR > 1 is harm), the two
population references are θ† and θ‡, biases are reported as OR differences and
in SD units on the **log-OR** scale, the bound-location ladder is the
dispositions', and `fs_sim_bias_coverage()` runs with `scale = "log"`. Pure
consumer of `results` — no simulation happens below this line.

```{r summary-prep}
#| message: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(gt); library(ggplot2); library(knitr) })

rd <- results[results$status %in% "DETECTED", , drop = FALSE]
n_batch <- length(sim_ids)

# No orientation bridge on this design: every estimator column and betaHhat_*
# are ORs with OR > 1 = harm.  `.orient` is kept (as 1) so the ported code
# reads unchanged.
#
# TWO SCALES, per R/fs_mr_inference.R:480-488.  The gate's WORKING scale here is
# the log-OR and its EFFECT scale is the OR:
#   * on the EFFECT (OR) scale: every *_est / est2 / bound column, and the
#     stored Wald and IJ intervals;
#   * on the WORKING (log-OR) scale: the stored SE columns (nv_*_se, mr_*_se_ij),
#     the field's lambda_mean / se_field (= lambda_sd) and the seven Lambda*
#     quantiles.
# So: est2 = exp(log(beta-tilde) - lambda_mean), lower_1s = exp(log(beta-tilde) - q95),
# upper_1s = exp(log(beta-tilde^c) - q05); lambda_mean can be NEGATIVE (it is a
# log-scale correction, not a bound); and every SE-to-SD ratio below is taken
# against SD(log est), never SD(est).
.orient <- if (isTRUE(adverse_outcome)) 1 else -1
stopifnot(.orient == 1)
rd$bH   <- rd$betaHhat_H
rd$bHc  <- rd$betaHhat_Hc
res_or  <- results          # no transform needed for fs_sim_bias_coverage()

.mfin   <- function(x) { x <- x[is.finite(x)]; if (length(x)) mean(x) else NA_real_ }
.sdfin  <- function(x) { x <- x[is.finite(x)]; if (length(x) > 1L) sd(x) else NA_real_ }
.medfin <- function(x) { x <- x[is.finite(x)]; if (length(x)) stats::median(x) else NA_real_ }
# SD on the LOG-OR scale: the working scale for bias-in-SD-units (task §3.1).
.sdlog  <- function(x) { x <- x[is.finite(x) & x > 0]; if (length(x) > 1L) sd(log(x)) else NA_real_ }
.biaslog <- function(e, tgt) {
  tgt <- rep_len(tgt, length(e))
  ok <- is.finite(e) & e > 0 & is.finite(tgt) & tgt > 0
  if (!any(ok)) return(NA_real_)
  mean(log(e[ok]) - log(tgt[ok]))
}
.cover  <- function(target, lo, hi) {
  target <- rep_len(target, length(lo))
  ok <- is.finite(target) & is.finite(lo) & is.finite(hi)
  if (!any(ok)) return(NA_real_)
  mean(target[ok] >= lo[ok] & target[ok] <= hi[ok])
}
.cov_n <- function(target, lo, hi) {
  target <- rep_len(target, length(lo))
  ok <- is.finite(target) & is.finite(lo) & is.finite(hi)
  if (!any(ok)) return(c(NA_real_, 0L))
  c(mean(target[ok] >= lo[ok] & target[ok] <= hi[ok]), sum(ok))
}
.cov1_n <- function(target, b1, side = "lower") {
  target <- rep_len(target, length(b1))
  ok <- is.finite(target) & is.finite(b1)
  if (!any(ok)) return(c(NA_real_, 0L))
  c(if (identical(side, "upper")) mean(target[ok] <= b1[ok]) else mean(target[ok] >= b1[ok]), sum(ok))
}
.wilson <- function(x, n, z = qnorm(0.975)) {
  if (!is.finite(x) || !is.finite(n) || n <= 0) return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
  ctr <- (x + z^2 / (2 * n)) / (1 + z^2 / n)
  hw  <- z * sqrt(x * (1 - x) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2)) / (1 + z^2 / n)
  c(ctr - hw, ctr + hw)
}

# Estimator rows for one block ([MD] :1291-1306).  FB never appears on this
# path; MR (field) appears wherever that block's field columns are finite.
fb_in_tables <- any(is.finite(results$fb_H_est))
est_keys_for <- function(sfx) {
  keys <- c(oracle = "or", naive = "nv", FB = "fb",
            `MR (IJ)` = "mr", `MR (IJ, winner)` = "mrw",
            `MR (IJ, winner-floor)` = "mrwf", `MR (field)` = "fld")
  if (!fb_in_tables) keys <- keys[names(keys) != "FB"]
  if (!any(is.finite(rd[[paste0("fld_", sfx, "_est2")]] %||% NA_real_)))
    keys <- keys[names(keys) != "MR (field)"]
  if (!isTRUE(show_winner_rows) ||
      !any(is.finite(rd[[paste0("mr_", sfx, "_se_w")]] %||% NA_real_)))
    keys <- keys[!names(keys) %in% c("MR (IJ, winner)", "MR (IJ, winner-floor)")]
  keys
}
.est_cols <- function(sfx, k) {
  if (k == "fld") list(e  = rd[[paste0("fld_", sfx, "_est2")]],
                       lo = rd[[paste0("fld_", sfx, "_lo2s")]],
                       hi = rd[[paste0("fld_", sfx, "_hi2s")]],
                       se = rd[[paste0("fld_", sfx, "_se")]])
  else if (k %in% c("mrw", "mrwf")) {
    vs <- if (k == "mrw") "_w" else "_wf"
    list(e  = rd[[paste0("mr_", sfx, "_est")]],
         lo = rd[[paste0("mr_", sfx, "_lo", vs)]],
         hi = rd[[paste0("mr_", sfx, "_hi", vs)]],
         se = rd[[paste0("mr_", sfx, "_se", vs)]])
  }
  else list(e  = rd[[paste0(k, "_", sfx, "_est")]],
            lo = rd[[paste0(k, "_", sfx, "_lo")]],
            hi = rd[[paste0(k, "_", sfx, "_hi")]],
            se = rd[[if (k == "mr") paste0("mr_", sfx, "_se_ij") else paste0(k, "_", sfx, "_se")]])
}

# The reference-target set per block.  [MD]'s `struct` / `marg` slots are
# RENAMED `dagger` / `ddagger`: the study's two population references are
# theta-dagger (the marginal OR in the block) and theta-ddagger (the CDE).
.blk <- list(
  H  = list(beta = "bH",  dagger = truth$marg_H,  ddagger = truth$cde_H,
            or_col = "or_H_est",
            label = sprintf("Harm  Hhat  (mean |Hhat| = %.0f)", .mfin(rd$n_harm))),
  Hc = list(beta = "bHc", dagger = truth$marg_Hc, ddagger = truth$cde_Hc,
            or_col = "or_Hc_est",
            label = sprintf("Complement  Hhat^c  (mean |Hhat^c| = %.0f)",
                            n_sample - .mfin(rd$n_harm))))
oracle_ref <- truth$marg_H      # theta-dagger(H): the calibration target
cell_lab <- sprintf("target_or_h=%s, n=%d [%s]", format(target_or_h), n_sample, subgroup_method)
# The bound-location ladder (the dispositions), used on BOTH blocks.
or_ladder <- c(0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.25, 1.5, 2.0)
.family_note <- if (identical(subgroup_method, "consistency"))
  "FS's candidate family is the prespecified cut grid, so the fixed-family condition holds." else
  sprintf("%s's candidate family is generated from a fitted surface, so every coverage figure below is coverage of the estimand CONDITIONAL ON THE PROPOSED FAMILY.",
          toupper(subgroup_method))
cat(.family_note, "\n")
```

## Estimation / coverage table (four targets) {#sec-estimation}

```{r estimation-table}
# TWO BLOCKS x FOUR TARGETS ([MD] :1418-1473), with theta-dagger / theta-ddagger
# in place of structural / fitted, and bias as an OR difference.
.build_block <- function(sfx, loc = "mean") {
  b <- .blk[[sfx]]; keys <- est_keys_for(sfx)
  beta_ref <- rd[[b$beta]]; or_ref <- rd[[b$or_col]]
  L <- if (loc == "mean") .mfin else .medfin
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(keys), function(lab) {
    ec <- .est_cols(sfx, keys[[lab]]); e <- ec$e; lo <- ec$lo; hi <- ec$hi
    se <- ec$se %||% rep(NA_real_, nrow(rd))
    if (is.null(e)) return(NULL)
    data.frame(
      Block = b$label, Estimator = lab,
      n       = sum(is.finite(e)),
      Loc     = L(e),
      SD_emp  = .sdfin(e),
      SE_hat  = L(se),
      b_beta  = L(e - beta_ref),
      b_or    = L(e - or_ref),
      b_dag   = L(e - b$dagger),
      b_ddag  = L(e - b$ddagger),
      C_beta  = .cover(beta_ref, lo, hi),
      C_or    = .cover(or_ref,   lo, hi),
      C_dag   = .cover(b$dagger, lo, hi),
      C_ddag  = .cover(b$ddagger, lo, hi),
      Width   = L(hi - lo),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}
.est_gt <- function(tab, title, subtitle, loc = "mean") {
  gt(tab, groupname_col = "Block") |>
    tab_header(title = title, subtitle = subtitle) |>
    fmt_number(columns = c(Loc, SD_emp, SE_hat, b_beta, b_or, b_dag, b_ddag, Width), decimals = 3) |>
    fmt_number(columns = c(C_beta, C_or, C_dag, C_ddag), decimals = 3) |>
    cols_label(n = "n", Loc = if (loc == "mean") "Mean OR" else "Median OR",
               SD_emp = "SD (emp)", SE_hat = if (loc == "mean") "Mean SE (log-OR)" else "Median SE (log-OR)",
               Width = if (loc == "mean") "Mean CI width" else "Median CI width",
               b_beta = md("vs $\\beta(\\widehat H)$"), b_or = "vs oracle",
               b_dag = md("vs $\\theta^{\\dagger}$"), b_ddag = md("vs $\\theta^{\\ddagger}$"),
               C_beta = md("$\\beta(\\widehat H)$"), C_or = "oracle",
               C_dag = md("$\\theta^{\\dagger}$"), C_ddag = md("$\\theta^{\\ddagger}$")) |>
    tab_spanner(label = "Bias (OR difference)", columns = c(b_beta, b_or, b_dag, b_ddag)) |>
    tab_spanner(label = "95% coverage of", columns = c(C_beta, C_or, C_dag, C_ddag)) |>
    tab_footnote(footnote = md(paste(
      "Every estimate and bound is an ODDS RATIO; OR > 1 is harm (`adverse_outcome = TRUE`, no flip).",
      "Bias here is the OR difference; bias in SD units on the log-OR scale is in the Table-2 layout below.",
      "Every stored SE column is on the WORKING (log-OR) scale: the Wald and IJ SEs, and the field row's Lambda-SD `se_field` (R/fs_mr_inference.R:480-488).",
      "**Targets.** *beta(Hhat)*: per-replicate exact conditional estimand at the REALIZED region (the Theorem 2 target).",
      "*oracle*: the per-replicate logistic refit on the TRUE region.",
      "*theta-dagger*: the population marginal OR in the block. *theta-ddagger*: the controlled direct effect.",
      "MR (IJ) = two-term de-biased estimate with the IJ interval; MR (field) = shrunk-field `est2` with the two-sided 95% Lambda-quantile interval.",
      .family_note)))
}
if (nrow(rd))
  .est_gt(rbind(.build_block("H"), .build_block("Hc")),
          title = "MR (IJ) vs MR (field): estimation & coverage (OR scale)",
          subtitle = sprintf("%s, %d sims, draws=%d, ci_method=%s, resample identification",
                             cell_lab, n_batch, mr_draws, mr_ci_method))
```

```{r estimation-table-medians}
  .est_gt(rbind(.build_block("H", "median"), .build_block("Hc", "median")),
```
