## Table-2 layout: bias, SD, SE, SE/SD, two-sided and one-sided coverage {#sec-table2}

The records' layout ([MD] §sec-table2): rows oracle / naive / MR (IJ) /
MR (field) per block; bias against $\beta(\cdot)$ as an **OR difference** and in
**SD units on the log-OR scale**; empirical SD; mean SE; SE/SD; two-sided
coverage of $\beta(\cdot)$ with Wilson intervals; **one-sided coverage on the
exposed side** — the harm block's LOWER bound (harm claim) and the complement's
UPPER bound (benefit claim) — with Wilson intervals; half-widths and one-sided
margins. The field rows use their stored `fld_H_lo1s` / `fld_Hc_up1s`
(Λ* q95 / q05 inversion about $\tilde\beta$); the normal-based rows use
$\exp(\log\hat\theta \mp 1.645\,\mathrm{SE})$ on the log-OR scale. The oracle row
is scored against θ†.

```{r table2-summary}
.tab2 <- function(sfx) {
  b <- .blk[[sfx]]; keys <- est_keys_for(sfx)
  side <- if (sfx == "H") "lower" else "upper"; sgn <- if (side == "lower") -1 else 1
  beta_ref <- rd[[b$beta]]
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(keys), function(lab) {
    k <- keys[[lab]]; ec <- .est_cols(sfx, k); e <- ec$e; se <- ec$se
    tgt <- if (k == "or") rep_len(b$dagger, length(e)) else beta_ref
    ctr <- if (k == "fld") rd[[paste0("mr_", sfx, "_est")]] else e   # the field inverts about beta-tilde
    # Normal-based one-sided bound on the LOG-OR scale, back-transformed;
    # the field row uses its stored OR-scale bound.
    b1  <- if (k == "fld") rd[[paste0("fld_", sfx, if (side == "upper") "_up1s" else "_lo1s")]]
           else ifelse(is.finite(e) & e > 0 & is.finite(se), exp(log(e) + sgn * z95 * se), NA_real_)
    okb <- is.finite(e) & is.finite(tgt)
    bias <- if (any(okb)) mean(e[okb] - tgt[okb]) else NA_real_    # OR difference
    bias_l <- .biaslog(e, tgt); sd_l <- .sdlog(e)                  # log-OR scale
    sde <- .sdfin(e); sem <- .mfin(se)
    c2 <- .cov_n(tgt, ec$lo, ec$hi); w2 <- .wilson(c2[1], c2[2])
    c1 <- .cov1_n(tgt, b1, side);    w1 <- .wilson(c1[1], c1[2])
    data.frame(Block = b$label, Estimator = lab, n = sum(okb),
               bias = bias, bias_sd = bias_l / sd_l, SD_emp = sde, SE_mean = sem,
               SE_SD = sem / sd_l,
               cov2 = c2[1], cov2_lo = w2[1], cov2_hi = w2[2],
               cov1 = c1[1], cov1_lo = w1[1], cov1_hi = w1[2], side = side,
               halfwidth = .mfin((ec$hi - ec$lo) / 2), margin1 = .mfin(sgn * (b1 - ctr)),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}
if (nrow(rd)) {
  t2 <- rbind(.tab2("H"), .tab2("Hc"))
  gt(t2, groupname_col = "Block") |>
    tab_header(title = "Table-2 layout: bias, SD, SE, SE/SD, two-sided and one-sided coverage",
               subtitle = sprintf("%s, %d detected reps; targets beta(Hhat) / beta(Hhat^c) (oracle row vs theta-dagger)", cell_lab, nrow(rd))) |>
    fmt_number(columns = c(bias, SD_emp, SE_mean, halfwidth, margin1), decimals = 3) |>
    fmt_number(columns = c(bias_sd, SE_SD), decimals = 3) |>
    fmt_number(columns = c(cov2, cov2_lo, cov2_hi, cov1, cov1_lo, cov1_hi), decimals = 3) |>
    cols_label(n = "n", bias = "bias (OR diff.)", bias_sd = "bias (SD units, log-OR)",
               SD_emp = "SD (emp, OR)",
               SE_mean = "mean SE", SE_SD = "SE/SD (log-OR)", cov2 = "2-sided",
               cov2_lo = "W lo", cov2_hi = "W hi",
               cov1 = "1-sided", cov1_lo = "W lo", cov1_hi = "W hi", side = "bound",
               halfwidth = "half-width (OR)", margin1 = "1-sided margin (OR)") |>
    tab_spanner(label = "95% coverage of beta(.) with Wilson intervals", columns = c(cov2, cov2_lo, cov2_hi, cov1, cov1_lo, cov1_hi, side)) |>
    tab_footnote(footnote = md(paste(
      "One-sided coverage on the block's exposed side: harm block, share of replicates with target >= the 95% LOWER bound;",
      "complement block, share with target <= the 95% UPPER bound. Field rows use their stored lo1s / up1s;",
      "normal-based rows use exp(log est -/+ 1.645 SE). `1-sided margin` = distance from the centring estimate (beta-tilde for the field row) to the one-sided bound, OR units.",
      "Bias in SD units is computed on the LOG-OR scale: mean(log est - log target) / SD(log est). SE/SD likewise compares the stored SE with SD(log est):",
      "every stored SE -- Wald, IJ, and the field's Lambda-SD -- is on the WORKING (log-OR) scale (R/fs_mr_inference.R:480-488), so the rows are on a common footing.",
      .family_note)))
}
```

## Bound location against OR thresholds {#sec-bound-location}

Bounds are read by **location** against clinically meaningful odds-ratio
thresholds, not as significance at OR = 1. The ladder (the dispositions):
τ = 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.25, 1.5, 2.0. For the harm block the table gives the
share of replicates whose one-sided 95% **LOWER** bound is at or above each τ
("harm of at least τ" is supported); for the complement, the share whose
one-sided 95% **UPPER** bound is at or below each τ ("harm of at most τ" is
supported).

```{r bound-location}
.bound_of <- function(sfx, k, side) {
  ec <- .est_cols(sfx, k); sgn <- if (side == "lower") -1 else 1
  if (k == "fld") rd[[paste0("fld_", sfx, if (side == "upper") "_up1s" else "_lo1s")]]
  else ifelse(is.finite(ec$e) & ec$e > 0 & is.finite(ec$se), exp(log(ec$e) + sgn * z95 * ec$se), NA_real_)
}
.bl <- function(sfx, thr) {
  keys <- est_keys_for(sfx)
  side <- if (sfx == "H") "lower" else "upper"
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(keys), function(lab) {
    b1 <- .bound_of(sfx, keys[[lab]], side); b1 <- b1[is.finite(b1)]
    if (!length(b1)) return(NULL)
    sh <- vapply(thr, function(t) if (side == "lower") mean(b1 >= t) else mean(b1 <= t), numeric(1))
    mc <- sqrt(sh * (1 - sh) / length(b1))     # Monte Carlo SE of each share
    names(sh) <- sprintf(if (side == "lower") "P(L >= %g)" else "P(U <= %g)", thr)
    names(mc) <- sprintf("mcse(%g)", thr)
    cbind(data.frame(Estimator = lab, n = length(b1), mean = mean(b1), median = stats::median(b1),
                     q10 = unname(stats::quantile(b1, .1)), q90 = unname(stats::quantile(b1, .9)),
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
          as.data.frame(as.list(sh), check.names = FALSE),
          as.data.frame(as.list(mc), check.names = FALSE))
  }))
}
if (nrow(rd)) {
  print(knitr::kable(.bl("H", or_ladder), digits = 3,
    caption = sprintf("Harm block: one-sided 95%% LOWER bound (OR) -- location summary and share at or above each ladder point, with Monte Carlo SEs. %s", .family_note)))
  print(knitr::kable(.bl("Hc", or_ladder), digits = 3,
    caption = sprintf("Complement block: one-sided 95%% UPPER bound (OR) -- location summary and share at or below each ladder point, with Monte Carlo SEs. %s", .family_note)))
}
```

## The conditional target beta(Hhat) vs theta-dagger

```{r betaHhat-callout, results='asis'}
ok <- is.finite(rd$bH)
if (any(ok) && is.finite(oracle_ref)) {
  keys <- est_keys_for("H"); keys <- keys[names(keys) != "oracle"]
  erows <- vapply(names(keys), function(lab) {
    ec <- .est_cols("H", keys[[lab]])
    sprintf("| %s | %.3f | %+.3f | %+.3f | %.0f%% | %.0f%% |",
            lab, .mfin(ec$e), .mfin(ec$e - rd$bH), .mfin(ec$e - oracle_ref),
            100 * .cover(rd$bH, ec$lo, ec$hi), 100 * .cover(oracle_ref, ec$lo, ec$hi))
  }, character(1))
  cat(sprintf("\n::: {.callout-note title=\"The beta(Hhat) target vs theta-dagger(H) - harm block, %d detections\"}\n\n", sum(ok)))
  cat("$\\beta(\\widehat H)$ is the exact population OR at the **realized** region",
      "$\\widehat H$ (OR > 1 = harm); $\\theta^{\\dagger}(H)$ is the population marginal OR in the",
      "**true** region $Q$ (the calibration target); their gap is the price of selecting the wrong region.\n\n")
  cat(sprintf("- $\\beta(\\widehat H)$: mean **%.3f** (median %.3f) - $\\beta(\\widehat H^{c})$: mean %.3f\n",
              .mfin(rd$bH), .medfin(rd$bH), .mfin(rd$bHc)))
  cat(sprintf("- $\\theta^{\\dagger}(H)$ referent: **%.3f** - oracle mean estimate: %.3f\n",
              oracle_ref, .mfin(rd$or_H_est)))
  cat(sprintf("- discovery gap, theta-dagger referent minus mean $\\beta(\\widehat H)$: **%+.3f** (OR difference)\n\n",
              oracle_ref - .mfin(rd$bH)))
  cat(sprintf("| estimator | mean OR | bias vs beta(Hhat) | bias vs %.3f | cov beta(Hhat) | cov %.3f |\n", oracle_ref, oracle_ref))
  cat("|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|\n")
  cat(paste(erows, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
  cat("\n:::\n\n")
}
```

# MR (field) diagnostics {#sec-field}

```{r field-coverage-wilson}
# Coverage with Wilson intervals against all four targets, two-sided (primary
# per the estimator's own interval) and one-sided on the exposed side.
if (nrow(rd) && any(is.finite(rd$fld_H_est2))) {
  cov_rows <- function(sfx) {
    b <- .blk[[sfx]]; keys <- est_keys_for(sfx)
    side <- if (sfx == "H") "lower" else "upper"
    tgt <- list(oracle = rd[[b$or_col]], betaHhat = rd[[b$beta]],
                `theta-dagger` = b$dagger, `theta-ddagger` = b$ddagger)
    do.call(rbind, lapply(names(keys), function(lab) {
      ec <- .est_cols(sfx, keys[[lab]]); b1 <- .bound_of(sfx, keys[[lab]], side)
      do.call(rbind, lapply(names(tgt), function(tn) {
        c2 <- .cov_n(tgt[[tn]], ec$lo, ec$hi); w <- .wilson(c2[1], c2[2])
        c1 <- .cov1_n(tgt[[tn]], b1, side); w1 <- .wilson(c1[1], c1[2])
        data.frame(Block = if (sfx == "H") "Harm Hhat" else "Complement Hhat^c",
                   Estimator = lab, Target = tn, n = as.integer(c2[2]),
                   Cov2s = c2[1], W2_lo = w[1], W2_hi = w[2],
                   Cov1s = c1[1], W1_lo = w1[1], W1_hi = w1[2], Side = side,
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      }))
    }))
  }
  gt(rbind(cov_rows("H"), cov_rows("Hc")), groupname_col = "Block") |>
    tab_header(title = "95% coverage with Wilson intervals (two-sided; one-sided on the exposed side)",
               subtitle = sprintf("Targets: per-replicate oracle; beta(Hhat) (conditional, primary); theta-dagger; theta-ddagger. %s", .family_note)) |>
    fmt_number(columns = c(Cov2s, W2_lo, W2_hi, Cov1s, W1_lo, W1_hi), decimals = 3) |>
    cols_label(Cov2s = "2-sided", W2_lo = "Wilson lo", W2_hi = "Wilson hi",
               Cov1s = "1-sided", W1_lo = "Wilson lo", W1_hi = "Wilson hi", Side = "1-sided bound")
}
```

```{r field-retained-bias}
if (nrow(rd) && any(is.finite(rd$fld_H_est2))) {
  ok <- is.finite(rd$bH)
  .ret <- function(est) {                        # retained bias vs beta(Hhat), OR difference
    d <- est[ok] - rd$bH[ok]; d <- d[is.finite(d)]
    c(mean = mean(d), sd_est = stats::sd(d), n = length(d))
  }
  rb_nv <- .ret(rd$nv_H_est); rb_mr <- .ret(rd$mr_H_est); rb_fld <- .ret(rd$fld_H_est2)
  sdl_fld <- .sdlog(rd$fld_H_est2); sdl_mr <- .sdlog(rd$mr_H_est); sdl_nv <- .sdlog(rd$nv_H_est)
  # Both stored SEs are on the WORKING (log-OR) scale, so both ratios are taken
  # against SD(log est).
  lam_ratio <- .mfin(rd$fld_H_se) / sdl_fld
  ij_ratio  <- .mfin(rd$mr_H_se_ij) / sdl_mr
  marg_fld <- .mfin(rd$mr_H_est - rd$fld_H_lo1s)
  marg_ij  <- .mfin(rd$mr_H_est - exp(log(rd$mr_H_est) - z95 * rd$mr_H_se_ij))
  hw_fld   <- .mfin((rd$fld_H_hi2s - rd$fld_H_lo2s) / 2)
  hw_ij    <- .mfin((rd$mr_H_hi - rd$mr_H_lo) / 2)
  print(knitr::kable(data.frame(
    quantity = c("naive retained bias vs beta(Hhat)  [OR diff.]",
                 "MR (IJ) retained bias vs beta(Hhat)  [OR diff.]",
                 "MR (field) est2 retained bias vs beta(Hhat)  [OR diff.]",
                 "naive retained bias  [SD units, log-OR]",
                 "MR (IJ) retained bias  [SD units, log-OR]",
                 "MR (field) est2 retained bias  [SD units, log-OR]",
                 "IJ SE / SD(log est)  (MR (IJ), both log-OR)",
                 "lambda-SD / SD(log est)  (MR (field), both log-OR)",
                 "one-sided LOWER margin, OR: MR (IJ)",
                 "one-sided LOWER margin, OR: MR (field)",
                 "two-sided half-width, OR: MR (IJ)",
                 "two-sided half-width, OR: MR (field)"),
    value = c(rb_nv["mean"], rb_mr["mean"], rb_fld["mean"],
              .biaslog(rd$nv_H_est, rd$bH) / sdl_nv,
              .biaslog(rd$mr_H_est, rd$bH) / sdl_mr,
              .biaslog(rd$fld_H_est2, rd$bH) / sdl_fld,
              ij_ratio, lam_ratio, marg_ij, marg_fld, hw_ij, hw_fld),
    n = c(rb_nv["n"], rb_mr["n"], rb_fld["n"], rb_nv["n"], rb_mr["n"], rb_fld["n"], rep(NA, 6))),
    digits = 4,
    caption = "Harm block: retained bias against the conditional target beta(Hhat) (OR difference and SD units on the log-OR scale), SE-calibration ratios, one-sided margins and half-widths."))
  print(knitr::kable(data.frame(
    metric = c("outer draws used (mean / min, of R_out = 1000)",
               "inner draws used per outer (mean, of R_in = 500)",
               "field block seconds (mean / median)",
               "replicates with a degenerate field (note set)"),
    value = c(sprintf("%.1f / %d", .mfin(rd$fld_H_nout), suppressWarnings(min(rd$fld_H_nout, na.rm = TRUE))),
              sprintf("%.1f", .mfin(rd$fld_H_nin_mean)),
              sprintf("%.2f / %.2f", .mfin(rd$fld_H_secs), .medfin(rd$fld_H_secs)),
              sprintf("%d of %d detected", sum(!is.na(rd$fld_H_note)), nrow(rd)))),
    caption = "MR (field) Monte Carlo draw usage and cost (detected replicates)."))
}
```

```{r field-complement-diagnostics}

                 "naive retained bias  [SD units, log-OR]",

                 "IJ SE / SD(log est)  (MR (IJ), complement, both log-OR)",
                 "lambda-SD / SD(log est)  (MR (field), complement, both log-OR)",
                 "REGIME: SD(log beta-tilde^c) / naive SE (both log-OR)",
                 "REGIME: lambda-SD^c / naive SE (both log-OR)",

              .biaslog(rd$mr_Hc_est, rd$bHc) / sdlc_mr,
              .biaslog(rd$fld_Hc_est2, rd$bHc) / sdlc_fld,
              .mfin(rd$mr_Hc_se_ij) / sdlc_mr, .mfin(rd$fld_Hc_se) / sdlc_fld,
              sdlc_mr / nv_se_c,
              .mfin(rd$fld_Hc_se) / nv_se_c,

              .mfin(rd$fld_Hc_up1s - rd$mr_Hc_est),
              .mfin(rd$fld_Hc_up1s_s - rd$mr_Hc_est),
              .mfin((rd$mr_Hc_hi - rd$mr_Hc_lo) / 2), .mfin((rd$fld_Hc_hi2s - rd$fld_Hc_lo2s) / 2)),
    n = c(rbc_nv["n"], rbc_mr["n"], rbc_fld["n"], rbc_nv["n"], rbc_mr["n"], rbc_fld["n"], rep(NA, 9))),
    digits = 4,
    caption = "Complement Hhat^c: retained bias against beta(Hhat^c) (OR difference and SD units on the log-OR scale), SE-calibration ratios, regime diagnostics, one-sided upper margins (field and field-s) and half-widths. Every SE-to-SD and SE-to-SE ratio is on the WORKING (log-OR) scale: the stored Wald / IJ SEs and the field's lambda-SD all live there (R/fs_mr_inference.R:480-488)."))
  print(knitr::kable(data.frame(

    value = c(sprintf("%.1f / %d", .mfin(rd$fld_Hc_nout), suppressWarnings(min(rd$fld_Hc_nout, na.rm = TRUE))),
              sprintf("%.1f", .mfin(rd$fld_Hc_nin_mean)),
              sprintf("%.1f / %d", .mfin(rd$fld_Hc_nfit), suppressWarnings(max(rd$fld_Hc_nfit, na.rm = TRUE))),
```

```{r field-bias-coverage-complement}
#| fig-width: 13
#| fig-height: 4.6
# Complement display (block Hc, side upper, log scale).  The field-s copy: the
# nine fld_Hc_*_s columns are copied over their unstudentized names in a
# DUPLICATE frame, so fs_sim_bias_coverage() scores field-s without any rename
# elsewhere (task's naming disposition).
if (nrow(rd) && any(is.finite(rd$fld_Hc_est2))) {
  .ests_Hc <- if (isTRUE(show_winner_rows) && any(is.finite(results$mr_Hc_se_w)))
    c("mr", "mr_w", "mr_wf", "fld") else c("mr", "fld")
  bcc <- fs_sim_bias_coverage(res_or, block = "Hc", estimators = .ests_Hc,
                              side = "upper", scale = "log")
  bcc$cell <- cell_lab; bcc$construction <- ifelse(bcc$estimator == "fld", "field", "IJ")
  res_s <- res_or
  for (nm in c("est2", "up1s", "lo1s", "lo2s", "hi2s", "lo_se", "hi_se", "se", "lam_mean"))
    res_s[[paste0("fld_Hc_", nm)]] <- res_or[[paste0("fld_Hc_", nm, "_s")]]
  bcs <- try(fs_sim_bias_coverage(res_s, block = "Hc", estimators = "fld",
                                  side = "upper", scale = "log"), silent = TRUE)
  if (!inherits(bcs, "try-error")) {
    bcs$cell <- cell_lab; bcs$construction <- "field-s"; bcs$estimator <- "fld_s"
    bcc <- rbind(bcc, bcs)
  }
  print(knitr::kable(bcc[, c("cell", "estimator", "construction", "n", "bias_log", "sd_emp",
                             "se_mean", "b", "r", "cov1", "cov2", "cov1_ref", "cov2_ref")], digits = 3,
    caption = sprintf("Bias vs coverage, complement block (one-sided = UPPER bound; log-OR scale); the `fld_s` row is the field-s copy. %s", .family_note)))
  print(fs_plot_bias_coverage(bcc[bcc$construction != "field-s", , drop = FALSE], side = "upper"))
}
```

```{r field-joint-pair}
# Simultaneous (H lower, Hc upper) pair: joint coverage of
# (beta(Hhat) >= lower_H AND beta(Hhat^c) <= upper_Hc) for the separate 95%
# bounds, the Bonferroni pair and the calibrated pair, for BOTH the
# unstudentized field pair and the field-s pair; margins in OR units.
if (nrow(rd) && any(is.finite(rd$fld_joint_gamma))) {
  rJ <- rd[is.finite(rd$bH) & is.finite(rd$bHc) & is.finite(rd$fld_joint_gamma), , drop = FALSE]
  .wl <- function(x, n) { w <- .wilson(x, n); sprintf("%.3f (%.3f, %.3f)", x, w[1], w[2]) }
  pairs <- list(
    `field: separate 95%`        = list(lo = rJ$fld_H_lo1s, up = rJ$fld_Hc_up1s),
    `field: Bonferroni`          = list(lo = rJ$fld_joint_bonf_loH, up = rJ$fld_joint_bonf_upHc),
    `field: calibrated gamma`    = list(lo = rJ$fld_joint_loH, up = rJ$fld_joint_upHc),
    `field-s: separate 95%`      = list(lo = rJ$fld_H_lo1s, up = rJ$fld_Hc_up1s_s),
    `field-s: Bonferroni`        = list(lo = rJ$fld_joint_s_bonf_loH, up = rJ$fld_joint_s_bonf_upHc),
    `field-s: calibrated gamma`  = list(lo = rJ$fld_joint_s_loH, up = rJ$fld_joint_s_upHc))
  jt <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(pairs), function(nm) {
    p <- pairs[[nm]]
    okp <- is.finite(p$lo) & is.finite(p$up)
    if (!any(okp)) return(NULL)
    covH <- rJ$bH[okp] >= p$lo[okp]; covC <- rJ$bHc[okp] <= p$up[okp]
    data.frame(pair = nm, n = sum(okp), joint_cov = .wl(mean(covH & covC), sum(okp)),
               cov_H = mean(covH), cov_Hc = mean(covC),
               both_bounds = mean(okp),
               margin_H = mean(rJ$mr_H_est[okp] - p$lo[okp]),
               margin_Hc = mean(p$up[okp] - rJ$mr_Hc_est[okp]),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  print(knitr::kable(jt, digits = 3,
    caption = sprintf("Joint (Hhat lower, Hhat^c upper) coverage of (beta(Hhat), beta(Hhat^c)) with Wilson intervals; margins in OR units from the two-term de-biased estimates. `both_bounds` = share of the %d scored replicates carrying both bounds. Mean gamma = %.4f (joint %.3f; Bonferroni %.3f) and gamma_s = %.4f (joint %.3f; Bonferroni %.3f); mean corr(Lambda*, Lambda*c) = %+.3f (field-s %+.3f); n_joint_draws mean %.0f. %s",
                      nrow(rJ), mean(rJ$fld_joint_gamma), mean(rJ$fld_joint_prob), mean(rJ$fld_joint_bonf_prob),
                      mean(rJ$fld_joint_s_gamma, na.rm = TRUE), mean(rJ$fld_joint_s_prob, na.rm = TRUE),
                      mean(rJ$fld_joint_s_bonf_prob, na.rm = TRUE),
                      mean(rJ$fld_joint_corr), mean(rJ$fld_joint_s_corr, na.rm = TRUE),
                      mean(rJ$fld_joint_n), .family_note)))
}
```

```{r identification-family}
# Identifier family sizes: MR's kept family K, the consistency-qualifying table
# (FS only), the band count (FS only), the admitted/proposed counts (GRF / DINA).
if (nrow(rd)) {
  .rng <- function(x) { x <- x[is.finite(x)]
    if (!length(x)) "structurally NA on this path" else
      sprintf("min %g | median %g | mean %.1f | p90 %g | max %g (n %d)",
              min(x), stats::median(x), mean(x), stats::quantile(x, .9, names = FALSE), max(x), length(x)) }
  knitr::kable(data.frame(
    quantity = c("n_family (MR's kept family K)", "n_cons_qual (consistency-qualifying; FS only)",
                 "band_n (within the band on observed effects; FS only)",
                 "admitted_n (GRF forest-qualified / DINA admitted)",
                 "dina_searched_n", "dina_proposed_n", "dina_tau_min (oriented)",
                 "p_hat_sum (selection rate over the family)"),
    summary = c(.rng(rd$n_family), .rng(rd$n_cons_qual), .rng(rd$band_n), .rng(rd$admitted_n),
                .rng(rd$dina_searched_n), .rng(rd$dina_proposed_n), .rng(rd$dina_tau_min),
                .rng(rd$p_hat_sum)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    caption = sprintf("Candidate-family accounting, detected replicates. %s", .family_note))
  wm <- results$warn_msg[!is.na(results$warn_msg)]
  cat(sprintf("\nWarnings: %d of %d rows carry warn_msg; distinct messages: %s\n",
              length(wm), nrow(results),
              if (length(wm)) paste(unique(gsub(" \\[x[0-9]+\\]", "", unlist(strsplit(wm, " | ", fixed = TRUE)))), collapse = " || ") else "none"))
}
```

```{r identification-figures}
if (nrow(rd)) {
  cov_list  <- lapply(rd$sg_def, rule_covs)
  cov_all   <- unique(unlist(cov_list))
  if (length(cov_all)) {
    cf <- vapply(cov_all, function(v)
      mean(vapply(cov_list, function(x) v %in% x, logical(1))), numeric(1))
    cf_df <- data.frame(covariate = names(cf), share = unname(cf))
    cf_df$true_region <- cf_df$covariate %in% subgroup_vars
    print(
      ggplot(cf_df, aes(x = reorder(covariate, share), y = share, fill = true_region)) +
        geom_col() + coord_flip() +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "firebrick", `FALSE` = "grey60"),
                          labels = c(`TRUE` = "true-region covariate", `FALSE` = "other"), name = NULL) +
        labs(x = NULL, y = "Share of detected replicates selecting the covariate",
             title = "Selected-covariate frequencies",
             subtitle = sprintf("True harm region: %s (upper-tail q%.0f cuts; prevalence %.2f%%)",
                                paste(sprintf("%s > q%.0f", subgroup_vars, 100 * sg_quantile), collapse = " & "),
                                100 * sg_quantile, 100 * truth$prevalence_Q)) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 12))
    rules <- sort(table(rd$sg_def), decreasing = TRUE)
    knitr::kable(data.frame(rule = names(utils::head(rules, 25L)),

                            share = as.numeric(utils::head(rules, 25L)) / nrow(rd)),
      digits = 3, caption = sprintf("Realized rules (sg_def) by frequency, detected reps (top 25 of %d distinct).", length(rules)))
  }
}
```

# Timing {#sec-timing}

```{r timing-distributions}
.dist_row <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (!length(x)) return(rep(NA_real_, 14))
  c(min = min(x), stats::quantile(x, probs = seq(0.1, 0.9, 0.1)),
    median = stats::median(x), mean = mean(x), max = max(x), n = length(x))
}
tim <- rbind(fit_mr_secs = .dist_row(results$fit_mr_secs),
             id_secs     = .dist_row(results$id_secs),
             fld_H_secs  = .dist_row(results$fld_H_secs),
             fld_Hc_secs = .dist_row(results$fld_Hc_secs))
knitr::kable(tim, digits = 2,
  caption = sprintf("Per-replicate seconds (all replicates; %s mode, %d workers). fit_mr_secs INCLUDES the field blocks.",
                    parallel_mode, n_workers))
```

```{r timing-projection}
mr_mean <- .mfin(results$fit_mr_secs)
fmt_hm <- function(sec) {
  if (!is.finite(sec)) return("-")
  h <- floor(sec / 3600); m <- round((sec - 3600 * h) / 60)
  if (h >= 1) sprintf("%d h %02d m", h, m) else sprintf("%d m", round(sec / 60))
}
wall_model <- function(ns) ceiling(ns / n_workers) * mr_mean
k_cal <- if (is.finite(elapsed) && wall_model(n_batch) > 0) elapsed / wall_model(n_batch) else NA_real_
proj <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(n_batch, 1000L, 2000L), function(ns)
  data.frame(n_sims = ns, per_rep_s = round(mr_mean, 2), cpu_hours = round(ns * mr_mean / 3600, 2),
             wall_model = fmt_hm(wall_model(ns)),
             wall_calibrated = fmt_hm(if (is.finite(k_cal)) k_cal * wall_model(ns) else NA_real_))))
proj$wall_actual <- c(fmt_hm(elapsed), "-", "-")
cat(sprintf("This run: %d reps in %s on %d workers; per rep fit+MR(+field) %.2f s%s.\n",
            n_batch, if (is.finite(elapsed)) sprintf("%.0f s", elapsed) else "- (combine)", n_workers, mr_mean,
            if (is.finite(k_cal)) sprintf("; realized overhead factor k = %.2f", k_cal) else ""))
knitr::kable(proj, caption = "Wall-clock projection: ceil(sims / workers) x per-rep cost, and k x that.")
```

```{r session-info}
.fmt_dur <- function(s) {
  h <- s %/% 3600; m <- (s %% 3600) %/% 60; sec <- round(s %% 60)
  if (h >= 1) sprintf("%d h %02d m %02d s", h, m, sec)
  else if (m >= 1) sprintf("%d m %02d s", m, sec)
  else sprintf("%.1f s", s)
}
.secs_total <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), .t0_doc, units = "secs"))
cat(sprintf("TOTAL wall-clock, start to finish: %s  (= %.0f s; %d reps on %d workers)\n",
            .fmt_dur(.secs_total), .secs_total, n_batch, n_workers))
if (is.finite(elapsed)) cat(sprintf("  of which the run loop: %s\n", .fmt_dur(elapsed)))
sessionInfo()
```
